articleTitle: Search the optimal combination of the geometric parameters of the ring magnet with a trapezoidal cross-section
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article attempted to calculate the optimal combination of geometric parameters of an annular magnet with trapezoid cross-section. For this results value of the magnetic induction was calculated for a magnet with a trapezoidal cross-section with different thicknesses and different combinations of geometric parameters. The dependence, according to which one of the best combinations of geometric parameters of the magnet with a trapezoidal cross-section is a magnet with large thickness.

articleTitle: Field — Emission cells with dielectric gap cathode — Call and perspectives of its application in electric devices
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This paper presents research results of field-emission processes in cells containing the cathode in the form of matrix points made of glass carbon and cell separated by the film of borom nitride. It is experimentally registered decreasing of surface insulating properties of the dielectric film inside of the cell in reaching the cathode current density 0,2 ÷ 0,3 A/см<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>, bringing to appearance of increasing leakage in the course of time in the circuit cathode-cell owing to sputtering on its surface the material of cathode.

articleTitle: Quasi-analytical calculation of wave impedance of hexagonal waveguide
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Quasi-analytical technique of synonymous determination of wave impedance of equilateral hexagonal waveguide with homogeneous dielectric filling is proposed. Quasi-analytical calculation of wave impedance of hollow equilateral hexagonal waveguide for different values of normalized wavelength in free space is carried out on a basis of this technique.

articleTitle: Perfomance conveoyr microwave electrotermal
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Energy efficiency — a direction vector in the design in order to achieve technological effect. In turn, economic efficiency determines whether the manufacture, sale and installation service. The relation between energy efficiency and cost-effectiveness on the example of a conveyor microwave electrothermal installations. The block diagram of the installation is described cell installation base and considered in detail how it works. It suggested several ways to improve the energy efficiency of the installation. The choice between these units carry out suggested by a technical — economic calculations.

articleTitle: Research multi-frequency mode of the three-gap cavity with resonant elements on printed circuit boards
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: We have studied the multigap resonance system, which is a rectangular cavity resonator with two suspended ceramic substrates, on which the two sides is applied by lithography strip line. During modeling process the resonator structure was calculated on three main modes with a maximum characteristic impedance, antiphase oscillation mode (π), π / 2 oscillation mode and in-phase mode (2π) oscillation mode. It is found that the π and π / 2 modes have significant dependence on the length of adjustment element, while in-phase oscillation mode (2π) weakly depends on the length of adjustment element and the dielectric constant of the substrate. The results can be used in the development of new types of vacuum microdevices multibeam klystron type with matrix field emission cathodes working in the S, C, X range.

articleTitle: Development of high-efficiency generator
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This article describes the development of a highly efficient generator, an overview of its relevance, scope of use, search for the best creation of the magnetic field, showed the advantages of this product, its structure and design options, the concept and the results of its work. As a result of this article, you can clearly see that the generator is more efficient than many modern counterparts. The article has scientific style and is designed for interested people.

articleTitle: Calculation of strength of electrical and magnetic fields at a distances commesurate with a length chanel of electrostatic discharge
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Electrostatic discharge is source of dangerous radiated electromagnetic interferences for semiconductor devices of printed circuit boards. Electric field radiated by electrostatic discharge at the distances commensurate with the length of the discharge channel reaches the high values and may lead to induction of currents and voltages which may lead damage of semiconductor devices and integrated circuits. The paper presents results of calculation of strength of electric field at a distance commensurate with a length channel of electrostatic discharge. The paper presents time domain diagram of strength of electric field when electrostatic discharge is occurred on printed circuit board.

articleTitle: Methods of calculating the strength of electric component of electromagnetic field in difficult conditions
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The authors presented a technique of calculating the strength of the electric component of an electromagnetic field for solving problems of electromagnetic microwaves propagation in radio electronic devices for different purposes. The technique is based on representing the surface reflection of electromagnetic waves in the form of a set of elementary emitters, for example, of Hertz elementary electric dipoles. The resultant strength of the electric component of an electromagnetic field is a superposition of the elemental emitters intensities taking into account amplitudes and phases, and polarization of electromagnetic waves. The estimated expressions and the conditions for their application are presented.

articleTitle: Study of impact lightning at of electromagnetic and thermal stability of fuselage of unmanned aerial vehicle
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this paper we propose an approach for the study and forecasting of the UAV fuselage stability at impact lightning. Example of forecasting the electromagnetic stability and thermal stability of the compartment UAV fuselage which made of composite material is discussed. The analysis of the study results shows the need to use technical measures to improve the stability of the UAVs fuselage at impact lightning.

articleTitle: Study immunity to disturbance of electronic system aircraft by influences of intentional ultrashort electromagnetic pulses
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: An approach based on the electromagnetic topology method for predicting immunity to disturbance of electronic system aircraft at the influence of intentional ultrashort electromagnetic impulses is discussed. Aircraft for small aircraft a fuselage and tail, which are made of composite material, are considered. An example prediction of immunity to disturbance of electronic aircraft control system and recommendations to ensure immunity to disturbance at the influence of intentional ultrashort electromagnetic pulses is discusses.

articleTitle: Switching cell for information transmission optical systems
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Various technologies of all-optical switches are considered. In the course of the analysis it is concluded that all the existing technologies provide the highest performance electro-optic technology. New optical switching cell is proposed. It is different from the known cells that the selection of the desired output takes place without the involvement of an external control device. That why the switching time decreases. The structure of the optical package and the principle of operation of the optical cell are considered. The cell structure is based on optical fiber Bragg grating and a ferroelectric.

articleTitle: The evaluation of hybrid active filter efficiency
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This paper devotes to the power quality increasing and electromagnetic compatibility ensuring problem in electrical networks of industrial enterprises with intensive application of nonlinear load, such as power converters of variable speed drive systems. The application of proposed hybrid active filter as a kind of effective decision for power quality increasing is presented in the paper. The proposed hybrid active filter includes shunt active filter, two passive filters and output high-pass filter. The proposed filter for voltage and current harmonic determination and elimination is described and justified by means of mathematical modeling and computer simulation. A mathematical model of generalized industrial electric network with nonlinear load and proposed hybrid active filter was developed by means of Simulink subsystem of Matlab software. During simulation the efficiency of proposed hybrid active filter is shown in different modes of voltage and current harmonic elimination.

articleTitle: The new ultra-compact waveguide bandpass filters on complex resonance diaphragms
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The problem of the electrodynamic analysis and synthesis of the waveguide band-pass filters on complex resonant diaphragms is solved. The diaphragms with an aperture in the form of a rectangular window with two metal L-shaped ridges are used. The possibility of creation by means of these diaphragms of compact and high Q-factor waveguide filters is shown. The approach allowing reducing significantly the longitudinal size of filters by use as impedance inverters of capacitive diaphragms instead of quarter-wave sections is offered. The practical realization of filters is enabled by drawing metallization on thin dielectric substrates. A good theoretical and experimental result matching is shown. The possibility of reduction of the longitudinal size of filters to three times in comparison with a classical quarter-wave design is confirmed.

articleTitle: The principles of ensuring high reliability of remote test monitoring
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The problem of providing improved noise stability of monitoring and diagnostic systems of digital devices of distributed information-control and information-measuring systems with communication channels, working in conditions of action of pulsed random high intensity noise discusses in this article. options for building of monitoring and diagnostic systems based on the model of K-ary information models that use secondary (protective) encoding on the basis of the code signal feature are proposed. The basic characteristics of such systems discusses too.

articleTitle: Multi-channel vibration measurement machine
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article highlights the problems of the efficiency of vibration test methods and means. It gives the brief overview of existing methods. It also gives characteristics of the developed multi-channel vibration measurement machine, its component parts and the benefits of its application. The test results are given that prove that the developed vibration vibration measurement machine allows to reproduce the necessary vibration characteristics similar to real-life vibration exposure during operation life of an object.

articleTitle: Simulation of power supply packaged magnetron for industrial applications
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Magnetron generators with different systems of magnetic field creation are used during industrial microwave devices construction. Technical and economic parameters of the generators are largely depended by the power supply source characteristics. Therefore, during the development stage of the power supply source it needs to have a model for studying of electromagnetic processes in the power supply source of magnetron generator under different circuit parameters. A simulation model of the 3 kW power supply packaged magnetron is built in MATLAB/SIMULINK. The simulation results characterize the mains voltage influence to the operating mode of the magnetron generator.

articleTitle: The aliasing errors at sampling signals of sensors with unlimited spectrum
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article proposes an approach to calculating the aliasing error when sampling signals from smart sensors. Antialiasing filter placed before the time discretization of an analog sensor signal (the developers are trying to receive a finite signal spectrum of the sensor). But errors of modern sensors sometimes reach 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−12</sup>…10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−24</sup> that makes the filter settings burdensome requirements on error of the filter and the recession slope of the response frequency. In the paper an attempt is made to estimate the error of aliasing and compare it with the other components of the sampling process errors. The used attempt can to make a decision about whether to use antialiasing filter or selecting parameters for obtaining the required sensor error.

articleTitle: Research and development of installation for microwave heating of concrete before pouring into molds
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article deals with the possibility of using microwave energy to heat concrete before pouring into molds. The experimental researches of increase of heavy concrete strength at microwave heating are made. The perspectives of the rapid microwave concrete hardening at 40–60 °C are shown. The possibilities of creating of high-power microwave installations for preheating of concrete mixtures using waveguide chambers are presented. Development of modular installation project for microwave heating of concrete before pouring into molds has been done. One installation module at microwave power 50 kW and plant capacity 10 m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup>/hour allows to raise the temperature of the concrete by 6 degrees.

articleTitle: Research on low-pass filter use as a miniaturization tool
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The application field of radio electronic devices is expanding, and with each year these devices become more complex. It is also true for devices, working within the SHF range. Due to the broadening of options of the radio electronic equipment, some devices become quite massive, and so a need to miniaturize them arises. This paper contains the analysis of miniaturization based on the microstrip filters usage. The filters numerical modeling is carried out and its phase-frequency characteristics are obtained. In the light of the gained results a proper lowpass filter was chosen that could be used as a miniaturization tool.

articleTitle: The fluorescencent multi-sensor array to selectively detect a presence of various heavy metals in aqua solutions
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper describes an approach to designing a fluorescent multiprobe array to detect the presence of heavy metals (HM) in the solutions. As a result of the selection of sensors the fluorescent probes — xanthene dyes, acridine and thiazine series have been selected to collect the array. Variations of the maximum values of probe fluorescence intensity have been employed as the analytical parameters to be sensitive to analyte's addition into solution. The fluorescent sensors were excited by both S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>→S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> and S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>→S<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> transitions. The responses of each sensor of the array versus different HMs are varied that allows the system to generate specific vector signals to each test substance. According to the obtained results the selective recognition of the received vector signal has been carried out by the principal component analysis and good recognition of test HM substances in solution has been achieved. Thus, a possibility to apply the proposed fluorescent multiprobe array for selective identification of HM salts in solution has been shown.

articleTitle: Heat treatment of sheet materials using slow-wave systems
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The method of calculation of the temperature distribution in the dielectric material for the traveling wave microwave devices is presented. The basic equations for the temperature distribution in the direction of the electromagnetic field energy propagation with considering the dependence of the dielectric parameters of a material on the temperature changes and taking into account the heat transfer to the environment for the arbitrary design of the electrodynamic system are obtained. The results of calculation and measurements of the temperature distribution of the material in the direction of the traveling wave propagationat the electromagnetic field frequency oscillations of 2450 MHz are given. The discrepancy of calculated and measured characteristics of the temperature distribution in the material does not exceed 10%.

articleTitle: Dual band compact polarizer based on ridged sections in square waveguide
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Dual band compact 90-deg waveguide polarizer for satellite communication applications is presented. The polarizer is based on double ridge sections in square waveguide. A proposed compact and easy for fabrication design provides very high performances within two standard frequency bands. CAD-oriented full wave technique for analysis of polarizers is based on Galerkin method, mode matching technique and generalized scattering matrix method. The eigenvalue problem for ridge waveguide is solved by Galerkin method with taking into account the edge condition. The weighted Gegenbauer polynomials are used as the basis functions taking into account the field asymptotic at the edges. This technique ensures fast convergence and high accuracy of the total hybrid solution. X/Ku-band square waveguide 90° polarizer is designed for operation within frequency bands 10,9–11,7 GHz and 14–14,5 GHz. VSWR within of two operational bands of polarizer is less than 1,03, differential phase shift is about 90°±1,2°. The length of polarizer is reduced at a factor 1,7 in comparison with the corrugated square waveguide polarizers.

articleTitle: Solid-state switch unit for modulators of power microwave devices
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper describes a high-voltage solid-state switch unit intended for use at output cascades of modulators of power vacuum microwave devices with grid control. The switch unit is composed of two identical high-voltage transistor switches constructed by stacking MOSFET transistor sections in series configuration. Both transistor switches are alternately driven on commands from a single control module with inversion of control pulse polarity. The experimental tests demonstrated that the switch unit enabled to form high-voltage pulses at grid assemblies of power vacuum microwave devices with amplitude up to 10 kV and rise and fall times of less than 50 ns.

articleTitle: Study of thermal IR sensor on the base of vacuum micro/nanoelectromechanical system with non-stationary thermocouple's seebeck effect
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper represents a new concept of thermal infrared sensor array based on the micro(nano)-electromechanical system (MNEMS) with non-stationary Seebeck effect. The application of Seebeck effect readout method in the sensing element using the “switchable” thermocouple is analyzed. The main characteristics of such a sensitive element for an IR imager array and their interrelation are discussed, i. e., the size of the element? that determines the imager spatial resolution; the frame time that specifies its response; the relaxation time and the output thermo-power of the thermopile. An increase of the input signal of the preamplifier can be achieved in that way which removes the stiff requirements for its noise figure and, ultimately, increases the sensitivity of an IR imager.

articleTitle: A method of reactive power measurement in industrial alternative current mains supplies
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A review of various methods for reactive power measurement is given. It is shown that they give different results under non-sinusoidal conditions. A new technique for parameter estimation of additive harmonics of the fundamental signal frequency taking into account the possible fluctuations of this frequency is given. It bases on the processing of the sampled current and voltage signals by the maximum likelihood method. The proposed technique allows one to obtain the efficient estimates of unknown parameters in linear approximation. The described procedure allows one to measure the reactive power in industrial alternating current networks using any of accepted methods.

articleTitle: Heat treatment of a rod dielectric materials using microwave radiation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of theoretical and experimental research in the field of high-performance microwave technology for the heat treatment of core material with low thermal conductivity are presented. The microwave method allows uniform heating of the dielectric rod throughout the volume, leads to the completeness of the polymerization reaction and high strength characteristics of the resulting products. Experimental studies conducted at the oscillation frequency of the electromagnetic field 2450 MHz, and the value of rod diameter of 20 mm. The discrepancy between the theoretical and experimental values of temperature in the material of the rods did not exceed 3% at the cross section, and the temperature deviation in the material of the rod from the nominal value of the temperature did not exceed 5 %.

articleTitle: Field emission structure with high current ribbon beam and the rotation of trajectories
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The field emission structure with thin conductive substrate of sufficient width and length with a double-sided emitting surface are tangent to the axis and coated with a nanoscale film of diamond-graphite clusters with pulling electrons grid is considered. The grid potential of the order of several (or tens) of volts generates a potential barrier. The electrons are emitted with approximately the Fermi velocity normal to the surfaces, and then their trajectories are rotated on 90 degrees using a focusing electrode and a longitudinal magnetic field. The electrostatic and magnetic focusing, ensuring the formation of wide and thin ribbon beam, are considered. The high current in wide band beam is achieved by increasing the width of the emitter and its longitudinal size (length).

articleTitle: Phase noise of the broadband microwave voltage controlled oscillator with tuning characteristic linearized by the diode converter
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The application of the voltage converter for the broadband microwave voltage controlled oscillator (VCO) is considered in this paper. Special attention is paid to additional phase noises of VCO by called use of the diode voltage converter. Studies showed, that at analysis frequencies more than 10 kHz additional phase noise spectral density can be reduced due to decrease of the converter load resistor value. On low analysis frequencies (less than 1 kHz) reduction of diodes number, used in converter, decreases an additional phase noise. For reduction of a phase noise at these frequencies it is necessary to use diodes with the low level of the flicker noise. It is shown, that when using low-noise detector diodes, the level of additional phase noises can be less than −10 dB/Hz at 10 Hz offset from the carrier frequency and less than −110 dB/Hz at the analyzed frequency equal to 100 kHz.

articleTitle: The architecture of intellectual system for monitoring of university students competences formation process
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The brief description of intellectual monitoring system of university students competences formation process using the complex-valued status function method is suggested. Algorithm for formation of SF are present. Monitoring system and possible aspects of intellectualized of this system are described. This work is devoted to the discussion of the intellectualization of the IS for monitoring of the processes of formation of cultural and professional competences during education of university students. Elicitation of main characteristics of competences which are widely discussed in literature and using of quantum-mechanical analogy give rise the method of status functions for description of complex socio-economical systems having large number of dynamical parameters and variables in multidimensional space.

articleTitle: Global scaling principle for simulation of powerful klystrons with high efficiency
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The Global Scaling Principle (GSP) is formulated. GSP allows to build a 2,5-parametric class of klystrons fully equivalent to one given prototype. Klystrons included in the constructed class, may differ significantly on the operating frequency, power, voltage, according to the number of rays and other key parameters. At the same time all the physical processes in a class of devices are identical. Accordingly, all klystron output characteristics of a class, including efficiency, gain, bandwidth, etc., are absolutely identical. GSP is very useful for the 2D-simulatiom of multi-beam klystrons. In this case GSP-analog is simulated instead of the initial multi beam klystron.

articleTitle: Optimization of microwave power transfer from electric field to the plasma inside an microwave 915 MHz plasma source
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This paper presents an optimization of the waveguide-supplied coaxial-line-based nozzleless microwave plasma source. This field applicator operated at a frequency f equal to 915 MHz at an atmospheric pressure. The optimization objective was to maximize an efficiency of power transfer from electric field to plasma inside this device. In the optimization we used a model of plasma which was determined in this work.

articleTitle: Resotrode with 2Π-regeneration — A promising new source of microwave power
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A new resonance device of the O-type, which was called resotrode with 2p-regeneration, is proposed. It contains 3-gaps input cavity with distance between the 1-st and the 3-ed gaps equals 2π. The device combines the advantages of the devices with modulated emission (IOT) and the advantages of the klystrons. Such a device has a high efficiency (90 % and greater), high gain (greater than 30 dB), small weight and dimensions, even at relatively low frequencies. The design of this device at 400 MHz frequency and power of 300 kW to be used in the Large Hadrons Collider (LHC) is considered and discussed.

articleTitle: Parameter estimation of superimposed sinusoids by data matrix subfactorization: Theory and algorithm
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Estimating parameters of a sum of complex exponentials in white noise is considered in this paper. A simplified maximum likelihood estimation algorithm based on subfactorization of a structured data matrix is proposed, and we show that parameterization of the data model in signal space allows to improve estimation accuracy at low signal-to noise ratio (SNR). The idea of solution of the normal equations is based on the singular value decomposition method of the data matrix, which allows one to simplify drastically the obtained equations. The geometric sence of the proposed solution is discussed.

articleTitle: Construction concept of cluster honeycomb systems decentralized electric power supply under the technology platform «small energy»
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article discusses construction of decentralized electric power supply systems based on the use of modern high-performance equipment for the joint production of electricity, heat and cooling using cogeneration and trigeneration technologies. Essential for the creation of such systems is the use of new types of high-efficiency power generation equipment (high speed microturbines and power generators with frequency converters), new ways to control the autonomous operating modes of electric power microsystem as well as new guidelines for the electric power microsystem collaboration with the existing centralized power systems through DC-link.

articleTitle: Sensitivity assessment of CCDs television sensors
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: For assessment sensitivity TV camera must know sensitivity a photoelectric cell. The purpose of the research: development of techniques assessment sensitivity of CCDs television sensors. Formulas for assessment of integral, spectral and threshold sensitivity of CCDs television sensors are received. The formula for determination of the optical transmission coefficient on brightness considering losses in case of coordination of the electron-optical transformer (EOT) and television sensor is specified. These dependences are applicable when using as object of observation of the EOT's screen.

articleTitle: Development program complex for the suppression of chaos in the process of corrosion of metals
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A software package is developed, that allows you to calculate the effective voltage pulse parameters to suppress the chaos of metal corrosion processes. It provides technique and the technical decision on the selection of the effective parameters of the signal for the suppression of corrosion processes. On the basis of the experimentally obtained values of the corrosion current having a casual look and complex evolution, based on nonlinear dynamics model, it is possible to distinguish between deterministic chaos of the stochastic process. Experimental results and the results of modeling the dynamics of the process of corrosion in metals are provided.

articleTitle: Calculation of whispering gallery modes in gyrotrons cavityes by the finite element method
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The finite element method for simulation eigenmodes of the gyrotron cavity is presented. Weak form of the boundary value problem based on the penalty function method is obtained. For the numerical simulations, Comsol Multiphysics software package is used. Field profiles, cold frequencies, and Q-factors for several cavity eigenmodes are calculated. The results are compared with the cross-sections method, which reduces the problem to solution of the inhomogeneous string equation. The numerical results are in a good agreement with theoretical and experimental results for the 330 GHz gyrotron [Torrezan A.C., Shapiro M.A., Sirigiri J.R. et al. // IEEE Trans. ED. 2011. Vol. 58. P. 2777–2783].

articleTitle: Reducing noise in the broadband TWT MM range through the use of electron guns with the field at the cathode
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of the calculation of the distribution of the magnetic field in the magnetic periodic focusing system with different screen configurations are presented. The calculations of the electron beam trajectories in the gun for different values of the field at the cathode are showed. The values of the magnetic field at the cathode depending on the ratio of the diameter of the screen to the outer diameter of the magnet are calculated. The results of modeling of electron beams focusing with periodic magnetic field with different values of the magnetic field at the cathode are presented. Experimentally shown that by using the magnetic field at the cathode there is a substantial reduction in the amount of noise in the O-type TWT.

articleTitle: Approximate solution for the magnetic field distribution in the cell of the reverse magnetic system with two soft magnetic inserts for microwave power tubes
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Analytical expressions for the longitudinal and radial components of the magnetic induction in the reverse magnetic system cell with two ring inserts in case of inner diameter of ring inserts greater than the diameter of the drift tube have been found with the magnetostatic potential approximation. The electron optics calculations of the klystron with magnetic focusing system containing high harmonic components have been given.

articleTitle: Criteria for selecting a predetermined electric potential with parametric generation in crossed fields
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This article is devoted to research process of generation of high frequency oscillation in crossed fields without using constant electric potential into interaction space. We consider the radial resonator system, with two coaxial cylinders and inhomogeneous magnetic induction, and determine electron trajectories in crossed ac magnetic and electric fields. Authors have shown the optimum parameters in selecting a given electric potential associated with parametric generation in crossed fields. The authors conducted a promising modeling of the generator by increasing the predetermined electric potential to disrupt generation process.

articleTitle: Turbulence in microwave electronics: Theoretical approaches and results of experiments
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The current status of the various theoretical approaches to the description of turbulence in the electron flow and electronic devices of ultrahigh frequencies (UHF) is shown. A three types of turbulence in nonlaminar electron flow were considered. The first type of turbulence is caused by the intersection of the electron trajectories (eg, due to thermal velocities) and it is common to all the electron flows. The turbulence of the second type is due to the instability of the electron beams, because of exponentially increasing of small perturbations (such instabilities are diocotron and slipping-instability). The third type of turbulence — vortex turbulence, whose origin lay filamentarization of electron flow. The results of an experimental study of turbulent electron flows and electronic generators with their use in stand-alone mode and in a mode of supply of an external signal were shown. The different types of broadband noise-generators of microwave oscillations were considered. We discuss the phenomenological model of turbulent electron flow which are chains of superradiant clots containing electron-oscillators, chains of «vortex» which describes by modified equations of Van der Pol.

articleTitle: Current electrical field intensity and distribution of charged particle density flat discharge plazma in lateral magnetic field
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This article examines calculated values of the electron temperature, the coefficient of volume ionization and parameters of motion variables of charged particles in a flat low-temperature plasma of inert gases. Obtained and analyzed chart of the current and the electric intensity and lateral distribution of concentration depend of the magnetic field. The article is shown that a lateral distribution of concentration becomes constant and independent of the magnetic field with increasing its value of the magnetic field.

articleTitle: Anticollision multiband RFID tag on surface acoustic waves
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The theoretical and experimental results of the design of new multiband radio frequency identification tags on surface acoustic waves in the frequency range 860–960 MHz were obtained. The tag contains three interdigital transducer, combined into a single microwave line. The necessity of using the multi-interdigital transducers is shown. The possibility of synchronous detection of up to a million tags from a distance up to 20 m was demonstrated experimentally. Localization region of such tags is up to 5 m. Miniature sizes of this tag allows its wide application in logistics, aerospace and manufacturing.

articleTitle: Analyse of sensitivity of dynamic characteristics of inverter at accuracy of its parameters
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The report describes the technique of sensitivity analysis of quality of transitional processes in inverter to the fuzziness of setting of parameters of curve and load. The technique is based on the use of fuzzy numbers, the principle of generalization Zadeh and idea of fuzzy sensitivity. The results of the calculation of the fuzzy sensitivity of oscillation, time of regulation and harmonic distortion factor of the curve of output voltage of inverter to the fuzzy settings of parameters of curve and load are represented.

articleTitle: The towers of overhead power lines for «smart» grids
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article shows the overhead line tower design for «smart» power grids. The tower is equipped with the information and measuring apparatus for the detection of emergency conditions. The principle of the diagnostic system is based on recording changes in the electromagnetic field around the line and tower during emergency conditions. It should be noted the ability to transfer power that exceeds the ampacity of the line as well as the risk of icing on the line elements that leads to breakage of wires are the main factors that threaten the normal functioning of the OHLs. Thereby it is proposed to create a «smart» tower containing both electromagnetic field sensors, mechanical loads and the current climate regime.

articleTitle: Parameter estimation of superimposed sinusoids by data matrix subfactorization: Analysis and results
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Estimating parameters of a sum of complex exponentials in white noise is considered in this paper. A simplified maximum likelihood estimation algorithm based on subfactorization of a structured data matrix is proposed, and we show that parameterization of the data model in signal space allows to improve estimation accuracy at low signal-to noise ratio (SNR). Basing on the proposed algorithm the computer simulation of the numerical example is accomplished. It is shown that the acheived accuracy is slightly less than the accuracy of efficient estimate corresponding to the low Cramer-Rao bound.

articleTitle: Voltage-to-frequency converter based on acoustoelectric effect
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The development of measuring converters with a direct voltage-to-frequency conversion represents significant interest. This paper describes the possibility of using acoustoelectric effect for the development voltage-to-frequency converters. The first part of this paper deals with the theory of the acoustoelectric effect. In the second part the design and the realization of the voltage-to-frequency converter based on acoustoelectric effect is shown and experimental results are presented. The sensitive element of voltage-to-frequency converter was fabricated from low-resistance CdS. Sensitivity of voltage-to-frequency converter reached 500 Hz/V. The length of sensitive element determines limits of conversion range which ranges from volts to about tens of kilovolts.

articleTitle: Research electrodynamic properties of layered composite the fractal structure
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A composite medium layered fractal structure was examined. Mathematical models of complex composite structures were developed using the effective medium theory. Algorithms and program complex, allowing exploring layered fractal structure designed. To describe the study of qualitative properties of composite media techniques are used fractal theory. The application of this approach through the conditions Takens criterion. The sensitivity of the fractal dimension of the elements of composite media structure to changes in their quality parameters calculated by the method Bolshakov — Dubrovin.

articleTitle: Design of level converters standard cells for circuits with clustered voltage scaling
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: As technology sizes shrink, the developers come upon a problem of static power. Among the different power reduction approaches with multi voltage there are, which can significantly eliminate components of power consumption on system level. But this methods isn't applicable for implementation within functional units. We are considering issues of practical realization such well-known low-level technique as clustered voltage scaling (CVS). We examine six different variants of level converters (LC) and combined flip-flop level converter (LCFF). All presented variants can achieve power reduction in practical implementation of CVS. Obtained experimental results show that proposed LCFF based on pass transistor logic can be reduce delay from 27 to 51% compared to standard LCs without penalty in power consumption.

articleTitle: The features of chip resistors usage in hybrid microwave integrated circuits
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: High frequency measurements from 3 to 15 GHz of chip-resistors are reported in this paper. The chip-resistors under test have been mounted in the gap of the microstrip line in two ways: with the resistive layer up («wrap around») and with the resistive layer down («flip chip»). The impedance of chip-resistors depends on its mounting method. Flip chip mounting method reduces the imaginary part of impedance: reactance value of flip chip mounting can be a few tens of percents less than the same value obtained using the wrap around mounting. Therefore, the refined model of chip-resistors has been designed. These results can be used for improving design efficiency of the microwave devices made by the hybrid technology.

articleTitle: Ultra-thin absorbing metasurface of millimeterwave range
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Along with conventional dissipative dielectric materials, various 2D periodic structures, known as frequency selective surfaces or metasurfaces, are used today for absorbing electromagnetic waves in microwave and terahertz systems. Usually they are fabricated in the form of thin resistive elements periodically arranged on dielectric substrate. Metasurface absorber with cross shaped conducting elements on ultra-thin silicon dioxide substrate is considered in present study. The influence of geometrical sizes on electrodynamic characteristics of such absorber is analyzed numerically. Metasurface under study demonstrates absorption higher than 90% in wide frequency band and can be successfully used in different millimeter wave range systems.

articleTitle: Investigation of characteristic of thyristor frequency converters for induction heating with simulation model
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Induction heating is one of the promising methods of thermal treatment of metals. Thyristor frequency converters that are complex and expensive electrical products are used as power sources of induction heaters. Information about the currents and voltages of the circuit elements is extremely important during the planning stage of frequency converter. Developed a simulation model of thyristor frequency converter in Matlab with Simulink expansion pack. Model has original blocks which enables the investigation of electromagnetic processes in the power supply system of induction heaters when the mode parameters are changed.

articleTitle: Simulation of high-current pulse to the electrode
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper studied the influence of the various factors (the nonlinearity of thermal parameters, phase transitions melting and evaporation, radiation and convective cooling of the surface material, and others) on the electrical and thermal processes during the heating of the metal electrode a high current pulse. A mathematical model and algorithm and a computer program to effectively carry out computer modeling of the thermal and electrical processes under the influence of a high-current pulse on the metal electrodes. Calculation of the thermal and electrical processes in the electrode is carried out on the basis of the corresponding non-stationary spatial axisymmetric model and through «enthalpy» method.

articleTitle: Structural — Functional scheme of detection devices of high overhead power lines by helicopter during low-altitude flight
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The basic principles to be met by structural and functional diagram of the device of detecting of high-voltage overhead power lines with low-altitude helicopter flight. High-voltage lines are a common cause of helicopter accidents. A possible structural and functional diagram of the device, as well as the formula to calculate the required sensitivity of the sensors of electric and magnetic fields. Detection of power line is a result of the registration of its electric and magnetic fields by device. The device does not disclose the location of the helicopter, since it is not a source of radiation, and registers only the field lines, which provides the helicopter with stealth low-altitude flight.

articleTitle: Modernization of the installation of high-frequency vacuum evaporator for growing piezoelectric nanostructure films of dielectrics
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The practical part of the work on the modernization of the industrial plant of high-frequency sputtering. The author's task was put to create a universal test bench with the possibility of a wide variation of sprayed materials. The versatility of the installation is the possibility of growing films of metals and dielectrics using the same sputtering target. The design of the experimental setup provides the ability to quickly change the reactive gas and spray material. Finally I got the opportunity on the basis of one plant to grow a lot of nanostructured films of metals and dielectrics, including piezo-active oriented films for the needs akustooptoelektroniki.

articleTitle: Calculation and optimization of multiple-inductor for pulse magnetization (Demagnetization) highly-coercive magnet
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this paper, we propose to change the structure of the magnetization inductor for magnets magnetized in the axial direction. This construction is characterized by the increasing from the center to the periphery (in axial direction) sections diameter. This approach has several advantages over conventionally used cylindrical inductor. In addition, we calculating the topology of magnetic field inducers, representing a set of circular loops with current.

articleTitle: Turn-on dynamics of small-sized triggered vacuum switches at fast rising of commutated current
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Results of research of starting modes for small-sized triggered vacuum switches (TVS) at fast-rising commutated currents are presented. The research was carried out for sealed-off TVS with discharge gaps of about 1 mm for switching current rise rates of more than 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sup> A/s. It was shown that the stable mode of TVS turn-on was disturbed by short-time current falls accompanied by high voltage spikes as result of instabilities of initial stage of vacuum arc. Unstable mode of TVS turn-on is characterized by an increased switching delay time as well as by increased energy consumption for vacuum arc formation. It was shown that the stable starting mode of TVS operation at fast-rising currents was restored by an increasing of the power of the triggering discharge, in particular, by application of additional peaking capacitors installed close to the TVS.

articleTitle: Introduction of a multi-port wave-correlator as promising receiver for software defined radio
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper discusses the usefulness and limitations of the modern receiver architectures for software defined radio (SDR) applications. A linear homodyne receiver architecture based on the multi-port technique is introduced and its suitability for SDR applications is discussed in detail. The limitations of the existing six-port based receiver systems are highlighted. The conventional receiver architectures are examined and it is shown that they are not entirely satisfying the requirements of SDR. The multi-port receiver successively avoids the drawbacks of the conventional technical solutions and can be used as a perspective device for modern digital communication.

articleTitle: Mathematical model of class E amplifier based on the harmonic balance method
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This work presents the application of harmonic balance method to the analysis of steady state mode class E amplifier using power tube. The mathematical model obtained by the harmonic balance method allows taking into account the finitude of RF choke and blocking capacitor values, as well as active element anode voltage drop in conducting state. The model does not use iterative methods of active element voltage calculation, which eliminates the convergence problem. The amplifier calculation procedure based on the given model allows increasing the accuracy of the amplifier elements values calculation. Due to that more accurate analytical calculation of the amplifier with given characteristics becomes possible.

articleTitle: Influence of concentration of emission centers in the form of windows through the film from the not stochiometric oxide of silicon on field emission of silicon of the carbon implanted by ions
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Use of field emission cathodes with high density of electronic current is capable to improve characteristics of electrovacuum devices and to give additional acceleration in development of vacuum microelectronics. For obtaining high density of current it is necessary to increase efficiency and concentration of emission centers. Improvement of field emission of characteristics at production on the flat autocathode of the distributed emission centers in the form of the windows done through a dielectric film is experimentally shown.

articleTitle: Experimental verification of the calculation of the ring magnet with a trapezoidal section by superposition method
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article describes the results of a natural experiment to verify the mathematical model for calculating the ring magnet with a trapezoidal cross-section. Shows the graphical model of calculated the experimental magnet, as well as its real counterpart, with the measurement of the magnetic field in the center of which are compared of results of calculation of the mathematical model. Displays summary of comparative table of the results of the calculation of the mathematical model, and the measurement of real analog computation model.

articleTitle: Pulse fluorimeter to determine the content of heavy metals in proteins
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this paper we propose a method and instrumentation for the study of the processes of quenching of the triplet states of luminescent probes and for determination of heavy metals in the human serum albumin and bovine serum albumin. The method is based on the quenching by heavy metal ions of phosphorescence of the probes, non-covalently bound to the protein globules. As quenchers we used heavy metal salts: nitrates of thallium, copper and cadmium. Erythrosine served as luminescent probe, because it has a significant quantum yield of phosphorescence and efficiently binds to the protein globules. The presence of heavy metals in solution leads to the formation of protein complexes «heavy metal ion — protein — fluorescent probe». Erythrosine phosphorescence was used as the signal sensitive to the presence of heavy metals in the proteins. Interaction of heavy metals with erythrosine leads to a decrease in the lifetime of erythrosine phosphorescence. Proposed method for determination of heavy metals is more sensitive in comparison with fluorescence method.

articleTitle: Operation-routing sequence of production of the radiation-hardened microcircuits of the structured array MH2XA010 for multichannel sensor systems
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article considers the features of the modernized technological process of production of the new BiJFETs radiation-hardened microcircuits of the analog master slice array (AGAMC-2.1) and configurable structured array crystals (CSA) on n-p-n-transistors with the cut-off frequency more than 2,2 GHz, on p-n-p transistors with the cut-off frequency more than 1,5 GHz and on resistors, produced on the low-ohmic semiconductor layer. The brief information about the new microcircuits of AGAMC-2.1 and CSA MH2XA010 is given, on the base of which a wide range of semispecialized microelectronic products can be designed for the analog processors and multichannel converters of the sensor signal of different application. The production of the concrete semispecialized microcircuits is provided due to the creation of conductors of the elements of CSA, which can be produced by the core enterprises.

articleTitle: Investigation of three-gap cavity, tuned on two multiple resonant frequencies
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of numerical investigations of electrodynamic characteristics of multibeam triple-gap resonator are presented. The possibility of achieving the multiplicity equal to two ratios of frequencies the fourth higher mode to the frequency of the main mode is shown. This setting will provide a quasi sawtooth law of variation of the RF voltage on the resonator gaps. When tuning the frequency of the main oscillation mode varies in the range of 18–19 GHz and frequency of higher mode have changed slightly — Δf<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">4</inf>≈0,06 GHz. For the considered modes were numerical calculated characteristic impedance ρ, the coupling coefficient M and related beam-loading parameter G<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</inf>/G<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>.

articleTitle: An experimental study of commutation characteristics of small-sized triggered vacuum switches
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper presents results of a study of commutation characteristics and triggering stability of small-sized vacuum switches with discharge gaps of about 1 mm. The experiments were carried out in microsecond range of pulse durations with current amplitudes from 50 A to 5 kA, and current rise rates of 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup> … 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sup> A/s. The upper limit of the commutated voltage range was limited by self-breakdown of the switches at level of 8 kV. The results indicate the most stable and fastest turning-on of the switches is achieved at the cathode triggering mode with positive control pulses. Leakage resistance as an indicator of triggering gap state enables us to estimate its breakdown voltage.

articleTitle: Field of application of visualizer for monitoring of terahertz radiation different power
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper is concerned sources of terahertz radiation different power. The paper dwells upon field of application of these sources. The authors gave a comprehensive analysis of powerful sources of terahertz radiation, sources of terahertz radiation of average power and sources of terahertz radiation of low power. In this paper the authors showed advantages and disadvantages of these sources. The authors put forward suggestion about field of application of visualize of THz radiation. In conclusion the paper points out that the new construction of visualizer will provide express monitoring of sources of THz radiation.

articleTitle: Huge cathode-heating units for relativistic electron injectors and powerful electron-beam devices
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The principles of creation of huge cathode-heating units with emitting surface a few hundred square centimeters are described. Proposed to use injector with thermionic cathode for forming the electron beam with current 500 to 1000 A and energy 500 keV. Emitting surface of this cathode should be a truncated cone form with a large diameter of 400 mm, slant height 30 mm, apex angle of 120 degrees and lateral surface 360 cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Suggested technological solutions for the manufacture of cathode preheating unit for the cathode.

articleTitle: Parametric generation in crossed fields
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This report tells about researching of parametric generation in crossed fields. The main attention was preformed to interaction space formed by two coaxial cylinders with an axial magnetic field is a possible parametric generation of electromagnetic oscillations in the absence of the constant anode potential due to inhomogeneous magnetic induction components. Equations of motion were solved numerically by the Runge — Kutta method in the approximation of a given electric field. Various modes of parametric generation including frequency multiplication modes were investigated. In final we conduct the estimation of efficiency for viewed generation.

articleTitle: Effect of low doses of gamma radiation on the transformation ir spectra of porous silicon
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The possibilities of modifying the IR spectra of porous silicon under irradiation by low doses of gamma — quanta of radioisotope source of <sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">226</sup>Ra and bremsstrahlung radiation are investigated.

articleTitle: Implicative algebra selection in the problems of static converters modelling
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: It is suggested the concept of a switching function used for the linearization of the static converter circuit in the analysis of steady-state and transient, defuse to the formal decision of problems of synthesis. The article shows the possibility of presenting switching functions in the basis of binary operations of choice of implicative algebra for the identification of individual variables with the energy of the process parameters and predicate variables with the parameters of the information process. The article obtain the logical-algebraic models for the typical energy transformations, which allows to reveal the structure of the switching functions and formalize the power and data circuits of static converters synthesis procedure by element basis, reproducing binary implicative algebra operations selection.

articleTitle: Microwave installation for mineral raw materials
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Research and development of microwave installation for high-intensity thermal treatment of the mineral raw materials on 50 kW at 915 MHz have been done. The possibility of using the working chamber of the waveguide-transmission type for the creation of efficient microwave installations, high power was shown. Device for sacrifices and movement of minerals in microwave working chamber was developed. The system of automation based on the industrial controller allowing to completely automate technological processing was created. Tested works of microwave installations for processing of mineral raw materials at a high microwave power level in the experimental workshop the mining and processing enterprise were carried out. The technological scheme of mineral raw material processing is developed.

articleTitle: Tunable RF coupler based on laterally coupled magnetic microwaveguides
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The surface and backward volume magnetostatic spin waves propagation in the side-coupled magnonic microwaveguides was numerically studied. The dispersion characteristics was calculated using the modification of finite element method. The transformation of the frequency dependence of the coupling length with the variation of the geometrical parameters was investigated. The cases of surface and backward volume magnetostatic waves were considered. It was shown that the coupling length is increased in the surface wave geometry. The influence of the external bias magnetic field orientation on the spectra of wave in laterally coupled structures was demonstrated.

articleTitle: Construction and manufacturing technology of photo emitter based on the use of carbon nanostructure with field localization
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper describes the basic design and technological features of vacuum photosensitive devices. Investigation of the possibility of intensification of the photoemission process using planar nanostructures with controlled localization of the electrostatic field, which are based on the film of diamond-like carbon, is carried out. It is proposed a phenomenological model that describes the tunneling of both equilibrium and nonequilibrium electrons into a vacuum from the concentration zone of the electrostatic field. It is shown that to provide high sensitivity, stability and durability of the photosensor the limit of concentration of equilibrium carriers using composite structures «DLC film on the Mo substrate» plays an important role.

articleTitle: Numerical modelling and optimization of heat treatment of dielectrics in the microwave oven installations of beam type of methodical action
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Mathematical models of electrodynamics and heat conductivity at microwave heat treatment of dielectrics which allow to solve problems of optimization of technological processes and installations, managements of their operating modes are offered. Problems of management of heat treatment of dielectrics in microwave to installation of beam type, working in methodical modes are considered. The developed models allow to consider movement of volume sources of heat in object of heating for installations of methodical action. On the basis of the carried-out mathematical modeling the optimum modes of heating of flat dielectrics in these installations are received.

articleTitle: Photothyristor control of neutral grounding mode of power transformers for limitations of geomagnetically induced currents
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article recommended the method of protection of power transformer from the influence of geomagnetically induced currents, by launching the resistive grounding mode at the period of geomagnetic disturbances and reversion to the solid-grounded mode on completing of geomagnetic disturbances. The article shows that for the identification of single-side saturation of the magnetic system of power transformer at the periods of geomagnetic disturbances could be used registration of simultaneous appearance of 6th harmonic and DC component of the magnetizing current in the neutral of power transformer.

articleTitle: Algorithm of reducing the time of resolving phase ambiguities of multi-antenna global navigation satellite system by using priori information
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Multi-antenna GNSS are widely used in various industries, it consists of three or more L1 GPS receivers. This system provides the high accuracy of relative coordinates determination (centimeter accuracy). The main drawback of this system is a long start period because of the need of resolving phase ambiguities. Analysis of the resolving was held and the method of reducing start time was proposed. It includes Ratio test and search of all candidates of LAMBDA method with a priory limitation and reduces the time the threefold.

articleTitle: Dynamics of changes in the plasma paremeters in microwave hydrogen ion source
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: For the analysis of changes in parameters of microwave discharge plasma used kinetic scheme of nonequilibrium processes. This scheme considers processes of elastic scattering, dissociation, ionization and excitation of atoms and molecules of hydrogen. Use Maxwell approximation for energy distribution of electrons. Presents relations of hydrogen ions and atoms concentration from time for different values of electron temperature. Also shows the dependence of the ionization constant and characteristic ionization time on electron temperature. This allows determine parameters of gas supply system.

articleTitle: Optimization of parameters dual mode quasi-fractal double-gap cavities for high-power multi-beam klystrons, operating at a frequency of 2,45 GHz
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: As a result of the numerical 3-D simulation it was determined the optimal process parameters of multi-mode interaction with a multi-beam electron flow for a new type of klystron spatially-developed double-gap quasi-fractal cavities (DFRC). Such cavities can be tuned at fundamental and doubled operating frequencies which are corresponding antiphase and inphase modes simultaneously. It is showed, that it is possible to control the spectrum and amplitude of the spurious modes due to insertion of the straps without a significant degradation in the interaction efficiency. This article proposes a criterion for evaluation the cavity interaction efficiency for different modes, including spurious ones. It is presented the maximum value of this criteria is achieved for 8-beam cavity design. It is shown, that the multimodal interaction mode parameters and reworked resonance system design provide stability when operating as the bunching dual-frequency cavity as a part of MBK, that operates at a frequency of 2450 MHz with a power output of 40–50 kW with an efficiency of about 75–80 %.

articleTitle: Quasi-static calculation of cutoff wavelengths of dominant modes of rectangular waveguides with one septum and two septa with central symmetrical placement of dielectric slabs in their capacitance gaps
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Analytical expressions for calculation the dominant mode cutoff wavelengths of rectangular waveguides with one and two T-septa with central symmetrical placement of dielectric slabs in their capacitance gaps are obtained in quasi-static approximation on a basis of equivalent network method. Results of calculation of normalized cutoff wavelength of the lowest mode of rectangular waveguide with T-septum with the central symmetrical placement of dielectric slab in its capacitance gap obtained by using the method of equivalent networks and the finite element method are compared.

articleTitle: Research of thawing soil using magnetrons
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Formulated mathematical model and the developed finite-difference method and computer program that enables the effective exercise of computer modeling and optimization of high-speed processes of thawing of soils with the help of the magnetrons. As the primary modeling method used a variant of end-to-end “enthalpy” method without smoothing concentrated heat capacity. Implemented a series of informative calculations for the case of Sandstone and sandy loam when the defrost magnetrons standard designs. The considerable influence of non-linearity of thermophysical parameters, phase transitions melting and evaporation, types of boundary conditions on the values of temperature and electric fields. The influence of the losses on the convective cooling and evaporation is negligible. The results can be used in the practice of research and design of digging in the permafrost zone.

articleTitle: Parametric generation in frequency multiplication modes
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This report considers investigation of parametric generation of high frequency oscillations in radial resonator system with crossed electric and magnetic fields. Usually an investigation in that system was conduct in case of parametric resonance or in case of frequency's double multiplications of ac fields. In this report, the authors show the fundamental possibility of parametric generation in crossed fields in mode when frequency of ac electric field sixteen time greater than frequency of magnetic field. In final the authors have assessed output parameters of considered generation.

articleTitle: Electron gun calculation in time domain
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The method and code of electron gun calculation in time domain are presented. The Poisson equation in 2D axial region is solved by integral equation method. For modeling in time domain algorithm «step by step» is used. Three meshes — one spherical and two rectangular — are used for potential calculation and equation of motion solving. The consistent scheme of distribution between mesh points of particle charges and calculation of electric field acting on particle is used. This scheme eliminates effect «self-action» of particles. The cathode current is calculated as space charge limited flow. The initial thermal velocities are taken into account.

articleTitle: Magnetic field of microwave ECR ion source of portable neutron generator
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Stationary magnetic field which necessary to electron cyclotron resonance formed by permanent magnets from alloy NeFeB. Computer simulation by code ANSYS allows us to find such configuration of permanent magnets that gives magnetic field strength equal 875 mT at input and output hole. Regulation of magnetic field distribution provides by special iron bars. Also, computer simulation shows that even slight change of position of the bars results to significant changes of ionization rate in resonators volume. This provides necessary conditions for effective ionization of gas in volume of the resonator. Ions highest production rate corresponds to resonance amplification coefficient equal 10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</sup>.

articleTitle: Influence of periodic ferroelectric layer on band gap's width in periodic ferrite — Periodic ferroelectric structure
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The structure of periodic ferrite with thin's modulation which load on periodic ferroelectric studied. The dispersion characteristics was calculated using the modification of finite element method. It is shown, that when ferroelectric load superimposed on the thickest part of the ferrite then changes of permittivity of ferroelectric load influence to band's gap width. It explains the reasons for the choice of such structure for such effect. The mechanism of the change of bandgap's widh for waves propagating in structure was explained.

articleTitle: Uncooled microbolometer arrays
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The basic theoretical and practical provisions necessary for the development of high-quality solid-state uncooled microbolometer arrays detectors of infrared radiation in this article. The state and prospects of development of microbolometer arrays on MEMS technology. The information about the microbolometer arrays developed by MEMS technology. The comparative characteristic arrays receivers of foreign production. The paper shows the application of a new type of high-speed multi-element thermal sensors based on VOx films with internal memory mode to monitor energy parameters of laser radiation. This development is in the process of the mosaic arrangement of heat detector on the receiving receiver site. The thickness of the heat-sensitive layer on the basis of VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf> film was 60 nm as an dielectric substrate, a mica ST-1 40 micron thick. When using the minimum number of measurement channels get an acceptable picture of the laser image.

articleTitle: Simple spice-neuron model
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In the present work we discuss the possibility to apply the equivalent circuit approach for modelling of the single neuron activity. The proposed approach is based on the using of the SPICE simulation of the well-known FitzHugh-Nagumo numerical model that consists from two first order ordinary differential equation. The SPICE model for FitzHugh-Nagumo neuron activity model has been developed in the form of two coupled closed networks that contains the capacitors and controlled current sources. So as result the right sides of the model differential equations are directly corresponds to voltage controlled current sources in the equivalent circuit. The simulation of developed equivalent circuit was carrying out in the LTspice environment.
