At The simulation procedure we change the control parameter z of the FitzHugh-Nagumo model and obtain the dynamical regimes as for known results for neuron activity for single input excitation and non-interrupted burst oscillation.

articleTitle: Analytical look at the evolution of the electrodynamics characteristics stopband periodic structures
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The analysis of the waves properties with complex propagation constants in periodic structures without disturbing the periodicity. The results of the electrodynamics characteristics research of different type structures in the wide range of frequencies are presented. The main attention given to study the phenomena the interaction of the normal waves of periodic structures with formation the stopbands with different dispersion laws and sufficiently small finite attenuation.

articleTitle: Design of wideband automatic network analyzers based on the multi-port reflectometer
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article describes a new technique for parameter optimization of the automatic network analyzers based on a multi-port reflectometer. The idea of optimization is founded on the appropriate arrangement of the measuring ports along the central longitude axis of the multi-port microwave tract. An optimization method of multi-port junction parameters for measurement in very wide frequency range is described. The technique offered is extremely efficient being added by the procedure of optimal control of measuring process consisting in the special choice of the weight coefficients of ports' responses. The results of computer simulation confirming the theoretical conclusions are given.

articleTitle: New principles for designing super-high power klystrons at significantly decreased operating voltages
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Possible ways for designing super-high power pulsed klystrons at significantly decreased operating voltages have been considered. They include the following: — the development of principles for designing klystrons with magnetron gun with anode modulation, positioning several such klystrons in a single solenoid with homogeneous magnetic field and summation of their output powers. — the development of principles for designing super-high power klystrons with multi-beam magnetron gun with anode modulation and several microwave power outputs. — the development of principles for designing super-high power klystrons with multi-beam magnetron gun with control electrode modulation and several microwave power outputs.

articleTitle: Propagation of current and velocity disturbaces in plane diode
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The propagation of current and velocity sinusoidal modulation in plane diode using 2D numerical model is studied. The linear regions are obtained when the first harmonics of current and velocity between cathode and anode are increasing proportionally with increasing of harmonic in start points. For two cases of modulation in start points — modulation of current and modulation of velocity — numerical results were compared with analytical solution founded using linear approximation. The first current and velocity harmonics behavior in plane diode for each tape of modulation are considered and good qualitative and acceptable quantitative accordance was obtained.

articleTitle: Adaptive transform network based of autonomous voltage inverters
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article describes the structural organization of the three-phase converter quickly reconfigurable networks constructed on the basis of autonomous voltage inverter with amplitude-width modulation. A multi-organization of power supplies at high and adjustable frequencies allows to operatively change operating modes of modules, adapting the network topology of the converter to the changing parameters of the load in order to reduce electricity losses, improve the reliability of power supply systems and ensure the required quality of the output voltage. It is proposed 2 options multi-module circuit solutions transforming networks to significantly reduce hardware costs by eliminating the reverse transistor bridges, introduction of diode inter-module links and expeditious shifting of some of the modules from the inversion mode to the recuperation mode reactive energy of the consumer.

articleTitle: Hate treatment in pushing microwave elecrotermal insttations based camera traveling wave
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Proposal to consider various options for the heat treatment of dielectric objects in pushing microwave thermal installation on the basis of the camera with a traveling wave. The block diagram of microwave systems and kinematics pusher installations the camera with a traveling wave, the calculated ratio and the detailed sequence of calculation of the matching profile unregulated camera waveguide traveling wave that provides uniform heating, the coordination of the working chamber to the microwave generator and high efficiency by the use of microwave energy. And also consider options to optimize the profile of the chamber.

articleTitle: About simulation magnetically shielded electron-optical systems forming convergent sheet electron beams
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A method of synthesis is developed, equations are derived and results are obtained via this method for simulation of magnetically shielded electron-optical systems that form sheet electron beams with compression. Relation that allow determination of the parameter of the electron guns and deformation of cross-section sheet electron beams in the magnetic field are presented Electron-optical systems with linear compression ∼10 and current density ∼ 100 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> of sheet electron beam are designed.

articleTitle: Semi-lossless traveling wave tube
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Output parameters of TWT having waveguide outputs are calculated over the frequency range from 26 to 40 GHz. According to the proposed design of the interaction space, the absorber begins at once at the input of energy to provide the TWT stability to self-excitation at the cut-off frequency of the waveguide. It has such a frequency-dependent performance that the attenuation falls with a frequency growth. This frequency dependence promotes the receiving of maximum efficiency of the device over the operating frequency range. Proposed absorber construction allows one to change both the attenuation value, and its frequency dependence over wide limits. It can be implemented without significant change of the existent «standard» construction of a helix slow-wave system of TWT.

articleTitle: Experimental study and field distribution modeling in grove waveguide at different variants of microwave energy injection
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The intensity distribution of the field along the symmetry axis of the dielectric — loaded groove waveguide (GW) for two variants of the injection into it of the microwave energy excitation of two counter-traveling waves and for the case of additive to feed him energy from the upper-trough are considered and experimentally investigated. It is shown, that the microwave energy injection from the upper quadrangular waveguides into the groove waveguide allows to provide rather homogeneous energy distribution in the operating zones of the groove waveguide and rather homogeneous interaction of microwave energy with dielectric material, moving through them. The initial data for setting three-dimensional fields — distribution modeling in such a system is formulated.

articleTitle: The investigation of microstrip bandpass filters with wide stop band
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Ten microstrip bandpass filters with wide high-frequency stop band are investigated with the help of the numerical electrodynamic analysis of 3D models. From each resonator bandwidth of the offered filters tuned with a relative width ∆f/f<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>=20% is formed by one lowest oscillations mode only. However at all microwave devices the extended high-frequency stop band is observed due to large leap of lines portions wave drags. Build-up of number of resonators in filters up to 6 order is resulted by growth of the steepness of slopes bandwidth and gain suppression of power at frequencies of stop bands. The width of high-frequency stop band at miniaturization of microstrip devices is reducing.

articleTitle: A study of a miniature dual-beam monotron oscillator with triple-gap resonator formed by integrated circuit technology
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper presents the results of numerical simulation of a miniature dual bean monotron with three-gap resonator, made by technology of integrated circuits. Was studied the stability of this device to different oscillation modes. It is shown that when working on main mode output power of the device on the 2,2 GHz is in the range from 150 to 350 watts with the change cathode voltage from 2 to 3,5 kV. The maximum value of technical efficiency of the device was 22 % at minimum a single beam current of 0,15 A. The proposed scheme of the device when using the field emission cathodes can also be realized in the millimeter wavelengths.

articleTitle: Calculation of noise figure for helix TWT
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The method of digital calculation of noise figure for helix TWT using 2d code are presented. The electron beam in helix structure enter was obtained after electron gun calculation with current and velocity modulations on cathode. The zero initial conditions for electron beam in helix enter for interaction calculation was changed by conditions which taken into account current and velocity modulations. The results of TWT electron gun calculation with converging beam and the current and velocity first harmonics behaviour in gun and drift region are presented. The influence of various factors on noise power amplifying as helix pitch, attenuator, location of helix enter in third, fourth and fifth PPM magnets are considered.

articleTitle: Phase transitions on silicon surfaces with local surface heating
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper considers the issues of burning metal jumpers on the surface of a semiconductor by current pulses of different shapes. Discovered that the passage of single rectangular current pulse with a duration of no more than 60 μs and an energy of 90 mJ observed the predominance of the processes of melting metal film over the contact melting at the interface. Current pulses of non-rectangular form with a duration of 80 μs and above with energy up to 250 mJ (rate of rise of current up to 50 mAμs) change the priority and the primary mechanism of destruction of the structures becomes contact melting.

articleTitle: Separation of a regular component from oscillatory process signal based on the analysis of phase trajectories
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper examines the way of separating a regular component in the electrical signal based on the analysis of the representative point trajectories in the phase plane. The work presents an algorithm for constructing the phase diagram of the process according to signals received from piezoelectric transducers. Mathematical support for calculation of the regular component based on the density analysis of the representative point trajectories is described. The paper gives an example of application of the method to the known dependences proving the efficiency of the proposed algorithm.

articleTitle: Operating features of DC source under unbalance mains
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Many devices need DC source with low ripple for normal operation. Three-phase bridge rectifiers are most commonly used as the base unit in the source. A simulation model built in MATLAB/SIMULINK is used to analyze the operating of DC source under unbalance mains. The simulation results characterize quality of output voltage versus unbalance of phase voltage.

articleTitle: Wide band strip-line microwave directional coupler for high power operation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A wide band compact 20 dB directional coupler has been designed, fabricated and tested for high power operation within frequency band 4–12 GHz. In order to obtain broad band frequency response a three-section asymmetric coupled strip-line directional coupler has been chosen. Since the phase shift between the even and odd modes appears by their propagation through the strip-line discontinuities, a degradation of the coupler isolation and directivity is observed. To compensate these parasitic effects the periodic structures are introduced on the outer edges of coupled strip-lines. The periodic structures delay the even mode more strongly than the odd mode. So the wideband compensation of the difference between phase velocities of even and odd modes are achieved. The coupler shows high electrical performances as well as compact size, low weight and easy-to-manufacture design. The proposed 20 dB directional coupler provides within frequency band 4–12 GHz the coupling characteristic imbalance 0,5 dB, isolation 35 dB, directivity 15 dB and VSWR<1,4. The allowable input power of directional coupler is up to 100 W. The coupler dimensions are 39×35×26 mm.

articleTitle: The mathematical model of nanocoating spraying in electric and magnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The mathematical model of spraying in a magnetron sputtering system (MSS), which is based on laws of the moving of charged particles in intersecting electric and magnetic fields, is given. The spatial structure of ion current density distribution near the cathode was considered as well as dependence of this structure and target parameters. The possibility of minimizing the spraying non-uniformity by numerical experiments and the target optimal geometric parameters selection are shown. In particular, it was shown that at a certain target cone angle it is possible to reach theoretical minimum of the thickness non-uniformity of the nano-coating at given other parameters and this may be useful at the design of MSS.

articleTitle: Analysis of the initial phase parametric generation in crossed fields
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This report tells about the behavior of charged particles in the crossed fields with parametric generation of high-frequency oscillations in the initial period of time. Authors consider the radial resonator system, with two coaxial cylinders and inhomogeneous magnetic induction, and determine electron trajectories in crossed fields. Trajectories were determined in case of ac magnetic and electric fields with different frequency relations. Electron trajectories in crossed fields were calculated numerically by Runge-Kutta IV order of accuracy. In final authors demonstrate output characteristics for that generation.

articleTitle: The frequency discriminator in 20–2250 MHz frequency band with parallel low and high frequency equalizer channels
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In our previous paper we described the sine signal frequency discriminator based on using the special RF equalizer in two channels RF system and these channels amplitude comparative function calculations. In this paper we show its advancement - the new three channels frequency discriminator with an extra RF equalizer. This frequency discriminator can be applied to processing of signals' with spread noise like spectrum and two tones simultaneous sine signals too. It allows determining the basic parameters of the incoming microwave signals such as power, central frequency, and its equivalent bandwidth or frequencies of two sine signals with equal amplitudes. The operation theory of new frequency discriminator and its main relationships are given. The prototype of the frequency discriminator was modeled, manufactured and characterized in 20-2250 MHz frequency range. In paper we give results of its work simulation with input band pass noise signal with relative bandwidth 120 percent, and experimental results on RF equalizers testing with sine signals too. The developed three-channel frequency discriminator is simple to produce.

articleTitle: A millimeter waveband klystron amplifier development
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A 8-mm extended interaction klystron with a sheet electron beam and a modulator was developed. The klystron operates at cathode voltage 10 kV and cathode current 2,6 A. Mathematical simulation methods and computer codes MEMFIS (electrodynamics system), CST Particle Studio (electron gun, interaction processes, collector) and Ansys Maxwell (magnetic focusing system) were used in the development process. Output pulse power 4 kW, relative bandwidth 1,5 % and low signal gain 52 dB were achieved in a optimization process. Cathode current density does not exceed 25 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. Modulator cut-off voltage is about 1500 V.

articleTitle: Analysis of dispersion characteristics of chain of coupled resonators with plasma channel filling and further design of plasma-beam travelling-wave tubes based on this method
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Equivalent systems method was implemented for designing the resonator slow-wave structures in plasma-beam devices, and non-impact plasma was used for the filling of the transit channel. The collation of the calculation results demonstrates the adequacy of the developed model in comparison with the real devices and structures. The analysis of the slow-wave structure dispersion characteristics was carried out. The structure of the plasma-beam travelling-wave tube high frequency unit was designed, and using the VEGA software, the tube parameters were estimated.

articleTitle: Evaluation of efficiency class DE power amplifier in the frequency band
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper presents the evaluation of efficiency of class DE power amplifiers (PA) utilizing either series or parallel compensation inductance and operating in the frequency band. Because of substantial dependence of PA mode from operating frequency and load resistance, incomplete recharge of output capacities in transistors occur at high frequencies thus reducing its efficiency. If the problem is solved by simultaneous decrease of load resistance and supply voltage, it will be accompanied by a substantial decrease in output power. The research aims to assess the maximum attainable power utilization factor of switching devices in the marked above variants of class DE PA and its behavior in the frequency band.

articleTitle: Investigation of ring microstrip resonators for a microwave microplasma source
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Microplasma microwave sources are widely used in a bio-microelectromechanical sterilization systems, in materials processing, in a microchemical analysis systems. The possibility of ignition of microwave low-power plasma using ring microstrip resonators tuned to the frequency of 900 to 1500 MHz was investigated. We have simulated the ring resonators with microstrip gap size of 100 to 500 microns. Prototyping model of the resonant systems on different frequencies was produced and investigated. The «cold» measurement of resonators to clarify the parameters and design optimization was carried out, the experimental equipment for investigating the microwave low-power plasma was adjusted.

articleTitle: Theoretical and experimental evaluation anamorphic factor in the hybrid acousto-optical imaging device acoustic fields
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Imaging spatially inhomogeneous acoustic fields is of considerable interest from the point of view of a various practical applications in the nondestructive examination, biomedicine and electronics. The most important task is to research new methods of imaging acoustic waves in a volume. The features of the imaging method of spatially inhomogeneous acoustic fields with a hybrid acousto-optical processor using Bragg diffraction are discussed. The presence of the phenomenon anamorphosing in obtaining the test image acoustic objects is shown. The comparative analysis of theoretical and experimental results of the researches anamorphosing in such device is given.

articleTitle: Structuring of silicon surface after vacuum-plasma treatment through discontinuous carbon film
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of structuring silicon surface after vacuum-plasma treatment through discontinuous carbon film are shown. The geometric and concentration features of silicon juts are established. The range of radius of rounding is 0.5–5 mkm depending on type of surface and treatment. The range of concentration 6∗10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">8</sup>–1.6∗10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">9</sup> cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> depending on type of surface and treatment. As shown the freon plasma treatment give more preferable parameter of silicon juts. The temperature depending exert influence on silicon juts too. For instance the features of silicon juts created after freon plasma treatment and high temperature have minimum radius of rounding and maximum concentration.

articleTitle: Investigation of natural frequencies of the multimode microstrip resonator and filter on its basis
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The natural frequencies of the multimode microstrip resonator «hairpin with stub» were investigated from its constructive data. Application in the resonator of the stub allows not only to observe on amplitude-frequency characteristic the poles of power attenuation, and also to considerably reduce frequencies of all its even modes of oscillations. At the same time frequencies of odd modes don't change. It allows to use in addition two resonances participating in formation of expanded bandwidth of the filter based on such resonator. High frequency-selective properties of such design are caused not only the poles of power attenuation located as near low-frequency, and high-frequency slopes of bandwidth, but also wide stop band.

articleTitle: Modeling the spatial energy distribution in the irradiated dielectric in its circular motion in an electromagnetic field
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The distribution of energy deposition in the dielectric layer, moving by circular paths within the electrodynamic system constructed of the plurality of parallel groove waveguides (GW) is investigated. The main simplified engineering models for calculating the microwave electromagnetic field distribution and energy losses in such systems are created. The calculations fulfilled for the case of dielectric objects, crossing the single groove waveguide showed the principle ability to realize rather homogeneous interaction of microwave energy with dielectric material, moving through such a system. The received basic relations are necessary for further rigorous simulation of the processes in the system of the loaded dielectric GW.

articleTitle: Detection of structurization of water by microperiodic magnetic fields
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Structurization of the distilled water is for the first time experimentally found by microperiodic magnetic fields. Fields in the water environment were created by plates from gallium — gadolinium pomegranate with the microperiodic magnetic and domain films which are grown up on a surface of plates at contact of films of plates with water. Also influence of an external constant magnetic field on features of structurization of water in such structure is investigated. Possibility of strong structurization of the water environment in this system is established. Results of measurements are executed in a wide strip of the Infrared range of waves and at the combined influence of EHF radiation in the range of frequencies from 35 to 78 GHz. By results of experiments range EHF frequencies at which structurization processes develop are revealed. Intervals of time of development of structurization before saturation and periods during which structurization of solution remains after radiation EHF are defined. The received results can represent considerable interest in development of EHF and TGhF of radio-electronic biomedical nanotechnologies of the future.

articleTitle: Accurate yield estimation of read access failure sram
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This work is focused on accurate calculation SRAM bitline voltage difference as main source of read access failure for deep submicron CMOS design. Accurate estimation minimal voltage difference allows increase memory performance and provide sufficient memory yield. We are considering a worst-case analysis that accounts for weak cells, and presents guidelines to achieve high yield has been proposed, but this method is too pessimistic and results in reduced performance of SRAM. A method to predict the yield of a memory chip based on the cell-failure probability is proposed in our work. The proposed method based on conditional probability of read access failure relatively sense amplifier offset and bitline voltage difference. Obtained experimental results show that discharge time is needed to get a minimal voltage difference can be reduce from 14,5 to 18,1% in 90 nm technological nodes.

articleTitle: Development of a series of high-powerful broadband continuous TWTs in frequency range from 1 to 18 GHz
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This paper reports the general view of continuous high-power TWTs manufactured in Stock Company «Reseach-and-Production Enterprise «Alm«z», designed in recent years. Also general parameters of high-power broadband helix TWTs in the range from 1 to 18GHz are presented. The width of the most TWT's frequency range — octave or more. TWTs has the output power from 500 to 1500 W. For some TWTs is described the design philosophy of slow-wave structures, cooling systems and heat rejection methods from TWT's helix, broadband energy outputs. The comparison of designed TWT to a number of constructive solutions of separate elements of the construction is also presented in this work.

articleTitle: Investigation optimal location led lighting source
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This article explores the illumination dependent on the distance between the elements of the LED array. Study the illumination depending on the distance was made between the LED array elements at different distances from the source. For this experiment scheme and laboratory equipment has been developed. A mathematical model of illumination from different types of LEDs using the computer system Origin Pro. Produced development schemes optimal arrangement of LED light sources, and also studied the basic parameters which are important for the development of the scheme.

articleTitle: Software for recognition of a rectangular pulse signal
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article deals with the software for recognition of rectangular pulse signals with different pulse duration and amplitude, consisting of a head module and the three modules that implement methods on the statistical characteristics — arithmetic mean, variance and standard deviation, based on the continuous wavelet transform (Haar wavelet). A rectangular pulse signal is specified as a sequence of characters — “zeros” and “units”. Recommended for recognition of a rectangular pulse signals with different pulse duration and amplitude, consisting of 10 characters, use the technique based on RMS, as the smallest number of levels for the recognition it gives the best result.

articleTitle: Measuring atmospheric condition, designed for operation in rough conditions
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A variant of construction of measuring the atmospheric conditions, intended to determine the ambient temperature, atmospheric pressure, longitudinal and transverse component of air flow rate in a wide range of climatic and mechanical effects. The block scheme of the device and its main components. The mechanisms of working elements of the device, showing the connection between them and the interaction interfaces. A method of determining wind direction and speed using the information about the pressure on the sides, two the rotated relative to each other prisms. The main characteristics of a measuring instrument developed state of the atmosphere.

articleTitle: Directional RF coupler with dual tunability based on laterally coupled multiferroic structure
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this work we report the experimental and numerical investigations of spin-electromagnetic waves propagating in finite-width multiferroic waveguide. Numerical simulation was provided by the developped finite-element method of electromagnetic eigenspectrum calculation. The control of electromagnetic spin wave spectra by the variation of dielectric permittivity was demonstrated. We show that the spatial distribution of magnetization of the width-modes in laterally confined multiferroic structure changes due to the electrodynamic coupling between the spin waves localized mainly in the finite-width ferrite layer and the electromagnetic waves propagating in the ferroelectric layer. The proposed structure can be used as tunable microwave coupler.

articleTitle: Sensitive element on the planar mushroom-shaped metamaterial investigation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The investigation of sensitive element on the planar mushroom-shaped metamaterial are considered. The results of numerical simulation sensitive element for measurement of physical quantities and monitoring parameters of technological processes using CST Studio Suite are presented. Also it is shown that the microstrip sensitive element has geometrical dimensions much smaller operating wavelength while maintaining a high Q-factor structure.

articleTitle: A model of the spin-dependent skew scattering in semiconductors
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The control of the spin Hall Effect with the polarization degree is an emerging strategy for including new functionality in spintronic devices. The dependence of spin hall conductance on spin polarization is reported. It is shown that skew scattering term depends on electrons temperature and spin polarization. We use the spherical harmonics method to calculate the dependence of the spin Hall angle on energy shift in the spin-polarized paramagnetic semiconductor. Transport coefficients obtained from the density matrix kinetic equation and spherical harmonics expansion. The skew scattering coefficient is computed numerically. It is shown that spin Hall coefficients nonlinearly depend on the degree of spin polarization. The results indicate that the spin Hall angle can nonlinearly depend on the spin polarization of the electron gas. This feature opens new way to control spin transport in paramagnetic materials like semiconductors or heavy metals.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling of the parameters of accuracy multilayer printed wiring boards
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Accuracy analysis of the basic geometrical parameters of multilayer printed wiring boards (ML-PWB) is considered. It is emphasized that ML-PWB, in contrast to many types of instrument making products may contain thousands of holes, and surrounding the contact pads on the accuracy of manufacturing which are increased requirements. The theoretical distribution laws (Gauss, Pearson, etc.) are considered as mathematical models of production errors. The calculations of the probability of acceptance ML-PWB using various models are presented. The results can be used in the technological calculations of accuracy parameters of ML-PWB.

articleTitle: Symmetric limiter HF and VHF bands of system remote control
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article presents the results of a study based output level efficiency constraints when the input signal level from the circuit receiving and amplifying devices. A comparative analysis of the scheme takes into account the efficiency of limitation of the input signal, the circuit complexity of construction, structural performance, easy setup. A comparison of the waveform, the test stops, leads to the conclusion that the most effective stop is symmetrical amplifier circuit — limiter on the two transistors. Satisfactory results showed amplifier circuit — stop using two comparators, a significant disadvantage is the complexity of the circuit construction.

articleTitle: Direct traction drive locomotive with the division stator and rotor
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Known designs direct traction drive does not completely solve the problem of a significant increase in the reliability and durability of the wheel-motor unit because they contain parts subject to wear and failures in service (bearings for the axle to compensate for the clutch), the replacement of which may require the dissolution of the wheel pair. The design of the direct drive traction to the rotor of wheel-motor on the axle and the stator, suspended from the bogie frame does not contain parts subject to wear, where to ensure the sustainability of the current switching converter, a correction that takes into account the movement of the wheelset relative to the bogie frame. It identified a number of requirements for such a drive structure. There is a sense for research designs disk valve-inductor engines as possible directions of development of the proposed drive.

articleTitle: Automatic correction of methodological errors in a reflectometer
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this paper we considered the method of automatic correction of systematic error of pulse reflectometer. We analyzed the main sources of errors in reflectometer. The analysis showed that the main source of error is the assignment of the phase velocity of the pulse. Expressions for calculating the error rate of the phase deviations of parameters of the line depending on the frequency. A functional block diagram of the method of automatic correction of the effect of external factors on the phase velocity. Using the results of this work will improve the accuracy of determining the place of accident and accordingly increase the commercialization of devices, developed on the basis of the adjustment method.

articleTitle: Methods of artificial intelligence in the tasks of information and measuring analysis and digital processing of quasistationary aerovideoimages
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Considered the problem of megacities traffic, offers an original technical solution for the automatic detection of the projection of asphalt pavement in the sequence of quasi-stationary aerial video photography, assesses the effectiveness of this solution in the task of statistical tracking of road traffic, proposed architecture of automatic measuring system on the basis of that solution, evaluated the prospects of such system. At the heart of the proposed technical solution is a combination of artificial intelligence methods and techniques of digital image processing. The main idea is in the automatic recognition of asphalt pavement projection in the video series. This saves time for image processing and enables statistical analysis of the traffic in real time. This is achieved by use of a digital low-pass filter (time filter) to the color pixel signals of images. After applying this filter for cars in the picture begins to emerge their filtration trail. Recognition algorithm detects such tracks and gradually forms the asphalt mask for video. So, after some time, cars will show where the road by themselves. After final recognition of asphalt pavement processing algorithm ignores the remainder of the frame, which leads to saving computation time. On perspective with this technical solution it is possible to construct an automatic measurement system for analyzing traffic flows in real time, and now developed solution allows in semi-automatic mode to calculate the number of cars and the average speed of traffic with less than 10 % errors.

articleTitle: Features process of formation of welds with iron metal for electronic devices
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: When choosing technological modes of diffusion welding of iron with metals it is necessary to consider that during heating of ferrite materials in a vacuum there is a possibility of changes in the structure and the main electromagnetic parameters of the ferrites. Given the large diversity of physical and chemical properties of the ferrite materials, it is necessary to assess the impact of vacuum-thermal effects on the parameters of virtually every type of ferrites, which will determine the future fabrication technology territorialistic nodes. Studies have shown that the heating of ferrite materials in a vacuum affects their resistivity, this is due to the oxygen loss ferrite material, but when you are heating up in the air ferrite materials to restore the conductivity that is due to the return of oxygen in the structure of ferrite. The analysis of the dependence of the strength of connections territorialistic nodes from selecting a temperature, welding pressure and time of isothermal aging, allows to choose optimum modes of welding.

articleTitle: Multitip field-emission cathode with the high aspect ratio tips made of carbon glass composed of electric gun
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This paper presents research results of electron gun characteristics with one and seven field-emission cells each of them contained autoemitter made of carbon glass in the form of needle with the high aspect ratio geometry and pulling grid separated from the cathode by the vacuum gap. In the pulse mode with the potential difference between the cathode and pulling grid 2813 V from the single tip with the height ≈1 mm and summit radius of curvature ≈3 mkm we got the current 14 mA. In the gun with seven needlelike field emitter with the potential difference between the cathode and pulling grid 1956 V the mainstream is 52 mA. The current passage coefficient to the collector is 40 %.

articleTitle: Detonation-gas treatment of solid surfaces
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Article associated with a type of gasothermic processing, namely the detonation-gas treatment, which today is less popular due to the physical characteristics of the process. Material is overview and summarizes the results of the work in the field of gasothermic. The article discusses the mechanism of combustion of hydrogen-oxygen mixture as the main working gas in detonation-gas spraying coatings. Graphically displays the mechanism of chain reaction and symptoms of active particles in detonation-gas stream. It proposed solution to the diffusion equation of the Fourier method for determining the parameters of the detonation products.

articleTitle: Development of structural schemes of measuring instruments for monitoring mobile communication systems
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In the course of studies structural sensors for monitoring schemes cover mobile network operator's area are proposed. Three main types of sensors are developed, which are intended to be placed on transport and stationary. Sensors collect data about the state of the cellular network signal into the measurement location and shipment to Web-Server is made. The main transmission channels from the sensors are controlled by the mobile network. For backup cellular networks of other operators or other standards are used, as well as other means of access to the Internet (wired connections, such as xDSL or wireless, such as Wi-Fi). Implementation of the proposed sensor circuit can reduce the costs of monitoring a mobile network and increase the accuracy of the information about the network state.

articleTitle: Research on compact topology of a hybrid ring junction on the basic of a bent transmission line
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This article is devoted to the research on a way to miniaturize a microstrip branch-line hybrid coupler. The construction miniaturizing is based on a simple bend of a microstrip line. This way is simple as it does not require complex mathematical calculations. During the process of design it was taken into account that compact devices should have similar characteristics to those of conventional constructions. In addition, the modeling of the suggested coupler at the operational frequency of 1000 MHz was carried out and its frequency-response characteristics were obtained. The suggested way of the miniaturizing allowed to reduce the coupler geometrical dimensions by 84 % in comparison with the conventional construction.

articleTitle: Mathematical simulation switched reluctance motor
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A mathematical model is developed to calculate the electromagnetic field in the cross section of the SRM. To implement the mathematical model was used the software package ELCUT-5.1. Two-dimensional boundary-value problem relative to the magnetic vector potential was solved by the finite element method and Newton-Raphson. Calculations of the characteristics of the electromagnetic field, static and dynamic torques, as well as the dependence of self-induction of the angle of rotation of the rotor. On the basis of computer models computer simulations that helped to explore the steady-state mode of operation of SRM-15/4000.

articleTitle: Investigation of the influence of technological modes of diffusion welding quality iron compounds with metals
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Quality ferritometallicheskih permanent connection nodes made by diffusion bonding depends on the choice of optimum technological modes. Investigation of the effect of diffusion bonding process regimes (temperature, pressure, and specific time delay) on the quality of connections ferritometallicheskih nodes was performed using the ultrasonic testing for the presence of defects such as cracks and chipped. The developed method of assessing the quality of multilayer compounds ferritometallicheskih possible to determine the optimum welding modes.

articleTitle: Porous plasma sprayed coatings having improved adhesion strength
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article presents the results of a study of porous plasma sprayed coatings based on magnesium-substituted hydroxyapatite. Technology described synthesis of magnesium-substituted hydroxyapatite by precipitation from aqueous solutions of calcium nitrate, magnesium nitrate, diammonium phosphate and ammonium hydroxide. Results mode plasma spraying on the basis of magnesium-substituted hydroxyapatite. It was found that the optimum for the deposition of magnesium-substituted hydroxyapatite is an arc current of about 350 A. These coatings have higher rates of adhesion strength to 14,9 MPa and held a maximum breakout force of the order of 5,4 kN. Optical microscopy of plasma sprayed coatings showed that the coatings formed by particles up to 50 μm with a porosity of about 15 μm.

articleTitle: Determination of the parameters of balancing process of multielement lithium ion batteries
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The method of selecting the number of balancing cycles multielement lithium ion batteries based on the search for a compromise between the increase in the maximum time of her discharge, on the one hand, and to reduce the stress range of rechargeable cells, on the other. The numerical experiments show that the realized effective balancing cycle for a particular type of multi-element lithium-ion battery ensures the stability of the discharge time, improving the performance of the battery.

articleTitle: Applied aspects of realizations on FPGA of intellectual control systems
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: For complex plants the composition of the intellectual control systems and neurocontrol is offered. The developed approach is based on: 1) synthesis of the stabilizing control law on the aprioristic information; 2) plant's parametrical identification on experimental data; 3) synthesis of the «exact» control law on the basis of the specified plants model; 4) realization of the «exact» control law an artificial neural network; 5) inclusion neurocontroller in parallel with a stabilizing controller. Definition of procedure of the control law synthesis is carried out by a planning subsystem on the basis of knowledge of the theory of automatic control.

articleTitle: Waveguide diplexer based on E-plane ridged sections and diaphragms
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A novel design of waveguide diplexer for millimeter wave applications is proposed. The diplexer is based on E-plane metal insert filters with ridged sections and longitudinal diaphragms in rectangular waveguide. The diplexer includes the E-plane waveguide bifurcation with parallel waveguide channels and stepped waveguide transition. The proposed diplexer design provides extended stop-band of the filters, increased attenuation within stop-band, high slope selectivity and reduced dimensions. CAD of filters and diplexers is based on mode matching technique, Galerkin method and generalized scattering matrix method. The eigenvalue problem for ridged waveguide is solved by Galerkin method with weighted Gegenbauer polynomials as the basis functions taking into account the edge condition. This approach ensures fast convergence and accuracy of the total hybrid solution. Ka-band diplexer is designed for operation within frequency bands 37,06–37,62 GHz and 38,32–38,88 GHz. Reflection loss within passbands of diplexer is better than −29 dB, isolation of the channels is about −48 dB. The length of diplexer is reduced at a factor 1,5 in comparison with the known designs.

articleTitle: Device for measuring density of solid materials
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper discusses principles for measuring density of wood on the basis of using the polarity effect for electromagnetic waves in anisotropic and isotropic substances. Relationships between velocity of propagation of orthogonally polarized waves and permittivity of substances measured are examined. Information parameters of polarized waves and their dependences on the parameters measured are identified. Errors in measurement results are analyzed and a method for controlling them is proposed. An application field for the solid material density measuring device is given.

articleTitle: Polynomial mathematical model of the one-gap klystron cavity
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article deals with the use of a technique of a modified method of the planned experiment to modeling of physical processes in the klystron and electrodynamic systems, developed by the operational method of calculating the klystron cavities, based on the use of approximate models obtained on the basis of equations with refinement coefficients, found by the planned experiment. Application of the developed mathematical models and based on these resonators synthesis software allows rapid design of optimum electrodynamic systems, without the need for time consuming and costly experiments.

articleTitle: Improvement of class E tube power amplifiers efficiency using new principles of grid voltages shaping
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper covers the ways of improving the efficiency of a tube Class E power amplifiers (PA) used in the output stage of high-power radio transmitters. Shifting PA in class E mode enabled to achieve anode efficiency of 88…93%. At the same time it led to a result that control and screen grid dissipated power in tetrode became one of the main factors hindering further improvement of PA characteristics. This problem can be solved by applying to the control and screen grids multilevel voltage with a certain parameters. It enables to increase either the anode efficiency or the output power. The examples of suggested grid voltage shapes and related to them PA characteristics are provided.

articleTitle: The modern status of native thermal detectors of laser radiation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The modern status of the native thermal detectors of laser radiation is shown in the application. The comparison of different types of the thermal detectors of laser radiation. The basic operational parameters of the thermal detectors of laser radiation, their advantages and disadvantages are shown there. Described new possibilities of creating effective multielement sensors, using the materials and processes of CMOS technology. An MEMS sensor thermocouple — Sensor and MEMS sensor module with the matrix. Create prerequisites for creation on their basis of multi-element uncooled infrared detectors with the number of elements of 32×31 to 64×62. Thermal detector of laser radiation shows voltage sensitivity 5,83 V/W with sizes of matrix 250×250 microns and the value of detectability D∗ = 1,5∗10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">7</sup> cm-Hz<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1/2</sup>-W<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−1</sup> Showing new semiconductor bolometers with a heat-sensitive layer of VO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">x</inf>, working on the basis of the phase transition of the first kind of semiconductor-metal.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling of the TWT-O in the nonlinear regime, with an amplification of wideband dual-frequency signal with the help of her single-frequency characteristics
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A mathematical model of broadband TWT, which allows for the mathematical modeling of nonlinear amplification of broadband dual-frequency signal with equal amplitude on the basis of information about the family of its single-frequency characteristics in the operating frequency band. This signal is widely used in practice for the assessment of non-linear properties of TWT. It is proposed for modeling in TWT allocate linear and nonlinear parts. The formulas that enable it to carry out on the basis of known characteristics for each frequency. In the linear part the linear amplification of the signal is calculated, and in nonlinear transformation is performed on its known family of characteristics using the Hilbert transform with considering of the instantaneous frequency of the signal modulated in amplitude and phase.

articleTitle: Metallophone and metal-ceramic cathodes for powerful amplitron
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this article the questions of increase of reliability and durability, high-power pulsed microwave devices M-type. Analysis of the work metal-alloy cathode in the device showed its lack of resistance to a pulsed thermal loads caused by back electron bombardment. The developed design of metal-ceramic cathode unit with water cooling, able to withstand a pulse thermal load and divert from the cathode to 120 W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup> average power. Applied a new method of impregnating cermet pallet of the active substance. Investigated the ratio of the diameters of the cathode and anode. Optimization of the distance between the cathode and anode has allowed to obtain the highest emission current density and the power output of the device. The result of the research, an assumption was made that the durability of the device with metal-ceramic cathode may be increased in 3–4 times.

articleTitle: Ensure of the effective electron devices engineering based on the links between the process design of machining and assemblage
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This article considers the problem of ensure of the effective electron devices engineering based on the links between the process design of machining and assemblage. The structure of the complex approach (complex of the design procedures) taking into account this links and real manufacturing situation is formed. Also, analyzes of the possible algorithms of realization of the complex approach (complex of the design procedures) in system of computer-aided planning of the manufacturing methods.

articleTitle: The application of nanotubular titanium dioxide for gas sensors
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The work considers possibilities to employ nanotubular (NT) titanium dioxide layers in order to develop gas sensors. The NT TiO2 layers have been fabricated by electrochemical anodizing of Ti foil with subsequent dissolution of metal layer. The technique to apply TiO2 NT layer over the substrate equipped with strip coplanar electrodes is developed. It has been found that the TiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> NTs exhibit a considerable chemiresistive effect at temperatures over 300 °C versus a number of organic vapors under ppm concentrations in air.

articleTitle: Devices for visualization of sources of terahertz radiation
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper is concerned devices for real-time visualization of sources of THz radiation. The author gave clearcut presentation of the basic principles of devices for visualization of sources of THz radiation. In this paper the author present advantages and disadvantages of these devices. The authors showed field of application of devices for real-time visualization. The author put forward the new construction of visualizer. The author believes that the new construction of visualizer providing express monitoring of sources of THz radiation. The new construction of visualize can be applied in professional practice.

articleTitle: Planar field emission cathode based on nanoscale carbon structure: Progress level and development trends
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of practical testing of previously proposed by the authors of the concept of constructing planar field emission structures based on the use of nanoscale diamond-like carbon film are presented. The complex of electrophysical and operational parameters of developed and manufactured multi-electrode cathode-grid assemblies is investigated — current-voltage characteristics; the level of average density of field-emission current J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">S</inf>, acceptable for long-term and stable operation of the unit for 1–8 thousand hours; the level of working potentials; the efficiency of the electron beam transport to the anode (93–99 %). We analyze ways to improve J<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">S</inf> to 0.5 A⋅cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">−2</sup> without compromising the durability.

articleTitle: Application of new statistical methods for triangular sensor signal analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Application of new statistical methods for triangular sensor signal analysis is considered. The critical parameter here is the center of the laser beam. It is shown that the proposed method allows increasing accuracy of the sensors. Experimental verification has shown that the use of center of mass technique decreases root-mean-square error in 50%. While the proposed centralized integral steps method gives almost the same error but the results are more stable and regular. Additional decrease of the error can be achieved by the use of optimal linear smoothing procedure. The proposed algorithms were approved and adapted to the microprocessor implementation.

articleTitle: The linearization of transfer characteristic «information input — Power output» of pulse-width converters
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article recommends the principle of commutative programming scan of the comparison signal. This principle allows linearization of transient characteristics «regulating pilot — output voltage» of pulse-width convertors. In the article obtained the expressions for determining the sequence of discrete samples, forming a functional scan reference signal. The functional scan is necessary for the linearization of the transfer characteristics of the PWM inverter DC voltage step-up type. The article shows the possibility of linearization of the transfer characteristic while limiting the output voltage to a safe level by means of a signal by dual-zone scan reference.

articleTitle: Obtaining vacuum-tight connections by the diffusion welding method under vacuum conditions while producing vacuum tubes
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The report is focused on improving a productivity and quality of welding seams. The seams was obtained by thermal diffusion welding under vacuum conditions on a modern installation UDSR — 200/250 — 1150/100 and used in producing of units of vacuum tubes. We described methods of examining the quality of welded connections such as: copper — constantan — copper, copper — ceramics VK94-1 — copper and copper — steel. Obtained joints was examined on the mechanical strength, the vacuum tightness, dielectric properties of the ceramic. The results of exams are presented.

articleTitle: The possibility of achieving high values of efficiency with small bunching length in the two-frequency klystrons
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A new class of high-power klystrons, which use a dual frequency input and dual frequency bunching cavities, is proposed. This klystrons have both the efficiency about 90 % and the small bunching length. The global optimization procedure for the dual frequency klystron with the characteristics, suitable for modern colliders, was held. It was shown that the bunching process in such a klystron is very similar to the Core Oscillation Method (COM) bunching process. Such a process was called COM2. The results of computer simulation and analysis of results are considered.

articleTitle: Control system of electrogeneration and lighting of the independent illuminant
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In article features of a control system of electro generation of the independent illuminant using solar and wind energy by their transformation by means of the electric generator are considered. The developed electric energy collects in the accumulator and moves on a power supply circuit of the LED lamp. The scheme contains the electronic system of regulation of the winding of excitement of the electric generator providing generator loading only after a set of nominal turns and a control system of lighting, consisting of the photo relay day-night and the control unit of light having the acoustic sensor, the motion sensor and the timer of endurance of time.

articleTitle: Electrodynamic parameters of the three-gap resonator with two spaced beams
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of numerical investigations of electrodynamic characteristics of multibeam triple-gap resonator with two spaced beams of millimeter wavelength range are presented. The possibility of achieving the multiplicity equal to three ratios of frequencies the two higher modes to the frequency of the main mode is shown. Setting the frequency of the investigation modes was made by changing the parameters of the coupling slots. The frequency of the main mode species varied 32–35 GHz range and frequency of higher modes have changed slightly — 102–103 GHz. For the considered modes were numerical calculated characteristic impedance ρ, the coupling coefficient M and related beam-loading parameter G<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">e</inf>/G<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">0</inf>.

articleTitle: Modeling of gas-discharge chamber of the microwave ion source
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Ion sources based on microwave discharge enables high ion beam currents due to the effective ionization of the microwave plasma. The analysis of different ion sources has shown that the creation of ion sources based on microwave plasma is quite realized technical task. Modeling and calculation of sources cavity resonators were carried out. The possibilities of using the rectangular cavity with oscillation in TE101 and the quarter wave coaxial cavity to the working chambers of ion sources based on microwave discharge have been shown. Approaches to the creation of new types of working chambers of ion sources based on microwave discharge have determined.

articleTitle: The electron-optical system with magnetic focusing based on sheet carbon nanotube field emitters for twt at terahertz frequencies
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This report presents the results of calculation of electron-optical system consisting of a sheet CNT field emission cathode with a microgrid spaced from the surface of the emitter at 100 microns. On the basis of experimental data, it has been designed electron-optical system with a sheet CNT cathode with linear convergence of 6,25, and with the beam current density of 4,46 A/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. The thickness of the beam in the interaction space is 0,16 mm. In this case, the simulation of the sheet electron beam, generated by electron gun has shown feasibility of obtaining of low-perveance flow with a small deformation in beam tunnel 0,3×0,8 at 25 mm slow-wave system length.

articleTitle: Powerful RF electro-vacuum devices for industrial, scientific and medical applications
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The report examines the most common microwave vacuum electronic devices (triode, tetrode, diacrode, klystrons, IOT, magnetron, gyrotron, BWO). It noted the main features of their work. The limiting parameters and characteristics of these electronic devices made to data. The estimation of the prospects of the use of ISM-technologies in the short-range microwave. It is noted that in addition to the use of traditional instruments (magnetrons and klystrons) certain application prospects in the frequency range up to 2 GHz have multibeam IOT, and in the range above 10 GHz have a low-voltage multibeam monotron generators.

articleTitle: Plasma dynamic research in the resonator of hydrogen ion source by trajectory model
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Consider solution of equation, which describe motion of microwave discharge plasma components, and take into account microwave field, magnetic field of permanent magnets and elastic scattering on hydrogen atoms and ions. This solution has a resonant character, moreover, it shows that average energy of electrons in exact resonance on several orders greater than the energy corresponding to the maximum ionization cress section. Also, shows solution of equations of electron motion between two elastic collisions. Electron trajectories may be very different from the elliptic orbits and from each other depending on closeness to exact resonance.

articleTitle: Evaluation of the noise level on analog-to-digital converter's inputs
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In article are considered the issues assessment of real normal-mode noise level in measuring cables and common-mode noise level on ground buses at several enterprises. On the ground bus there is a small level of sinusoidal noise 50 Hz (5–10 mV/m) and largely level of impulse noise (to 50 mV/m). During the day on the ground bus of 20 m about 100 powerful impulse noise with the amplitude of 15–20 V were observed. In measuring cables the small level of sinusoidal noise (to 1 mV/m) and big levels of impulse noise (to 10 mV/m) is also directed. The assessment of distribution laws of amplitudes of impulse noise showed that these laws are close to the normal law.

articleTitle: Mutual phase locking of two gyrotrons coupled with delay
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Mutual phase locking of gyrotrons is important for power combining applications, especially for electron-cyclotron-resonance plasma heating. In this paper, a model of two coupled gyrotron oscillators is developed and basic properties of the phase locking are studied. Time delay of the coupling signal traveling between two gyrotrons strongly affects the pattern of phase-locking regimes. The model is described by two delay-differential equations (DDEs). Domains of in-phase and anti-phase synchronization are calculated. The results of theoretical analysis are verified by numerical simulations of the DDEs.

articleTitle: COM-mode of bunching as a means to efficiency limit values of klystrons
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The ability to achieve the limit values of the klystron efficiency based on COM-bunching mode being considered. It is shown that the most important parameter affecting the transition to this regime is the lumped bunching length (LBL). The dependence of optimal LBL value on the number of cavities was obtained by the step-by-step optimization of different klystrons. It was shown that such a dependences of the different klystrons are almost the linear and pretty the same. The results of the simulation and optimization of klystrons of different types and for different purposes with an efficiency of about 90 % are presented.

articleTitle: Heating dynamic of plasma components in resonator of microwave hydrogen ion source
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Description of microwave discharge plasma electrons and ions heating occur with using conclusions of trajectory model. Presents equations describing changes of plasma components temperature, whose energy distribution function is similar to Maxwell. For compile these equations used kinetic scheme, considering processes of elastic scattering, dissociation and ionization of hydrogen atoms and molecules. From the cited data follows, that with increasing plasma degree of ionization occurs fast growth of average electrons and ions energy. This results to decreasing ionization rate and as a consequence to decreasing of energy efficiency of the ion source.

articleTitle: Management dispersion characteristics folded-waveguide with drift tube
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The results of the research management capabilities of dispersion characteristics folded-waveguide with drift tubes according to functionality of system of designed TWT millimeter wavelength range. The proposed modifications of the folded-waveguide with an offset of waveguide side walls relative to coupling slots provide an effective dispersion management in the operating frequency range. Constructive changes in the cavities cells of various modifications folded-waveguide do not affect the shape and size of its space interaction. The results of the comparative analysis of the characteristics of studied systems and classic CCR from the viewpoint of application of such structures, depending on their functional area, in traveling wave tubes O-type of the short-wave band are given.

articleTitle: Electromechanical characteristics of pulse linear electromagnetic engines of the longitudinal magnetic field as movement
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article describes the work of a pulsed electromagnetic linear engine according on each of the seven energy regimes. Each of the modes differs to extent of restoration of magnetic energy at the movement of an anchor of the engine. To this end, ranges of magnetic energy recovery coefficient, defining the boundaries of energy regimes have been established. The analytical method has received the generalized expressions of current of excitement, electromagnetic traction effort, speed of movement of an anchor of the engine and mechanical power as movement of an anchor. The specified electromechanical characteristics of the engine correspond to a design of magnetic system of the engine with a longitudinal magnetic field. Characteristics allow to execute comparison of power and dynamic properties of pulse linear electromagnetic engines in each of seven power modes. Such comparison will help to reveal both the undesirable, and rational modes of the electromagnetic engine, for example, with the best stability of energy of the working course of an anchor.

articleTitle: The calculation of the field emission cells with high aspect ratio of needle
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper discusses the possibility of forming electron beam in a field emission cells with high (∼ 1000) ratio of the tips' height of the glassy carbon to their radius of curvature. The possibility of creating such a field emission cell, protected by ions, without beam loss on the grid and on the anode is shown. A comparison of the characteristics between considered cells and Grigoriev-Shesterkin cells in which aspect ratio of needle was less (∼10–20).

articleTitle: Propagation of current and velocity disturbaces in converging electron streams
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The method of digital calculation of current and velocity disturbances propagation in converging electron streams are presented. The Poisson equation in 2D axial region is solved by integral equation method. For modeling in time domain algorithm «step by step» is used. Three meshes — one spherical and two rectangular — are used for potential calculation and equation of motion solving. The cathode current is calculated as space charge limited flow. The initial thermal velocities are taken into account. The sinusoidal modulation of current and velocities in cathode start points are introduced. Harmonic analyses is carried out to study the propagation of current and velocity disturbances in gun and drift region with PPM magnetic field. The boundaries of linearity for value of beginning current and velocity disturbances are determined.

articleTitle: Electromagnetic field in the resonator of neutron generator's hydrogen ion source
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Determine complex conductivity of the microwave discharge plasma in resonator of the ion source. Using CST Microwave Studio allowed us to calculate dimensions of the resonance microwave window providing necessary reflection coefficient and to find effective amount of microwave discharge plasma from condition of resonance preservation. This makes it possible to determine value of electromagnetic filed in plasma and get it relation with power of electromagnetic wave. Computations show that fulfillment of the condition electron cyclotron resonance results to large reduction of electromagnetic field amplitude.

articleTitle: On the migration of the melted areas on the surface of the semiconductor
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper discusses electromigration of molten zones on the surface of the semiconductor in the framework of the mechanism of melting of crystallization. Analyzed experimental data electromigration processes on the surface of monocrystalline silicon wafer after passing a current pulse through the aluminum film with energy up to 250 mJ with a duration of 400 μs. Of the evaluation of the speeds of migration of the melted zones of Al-Si in such conditions. For example, the system Ge-Ag is shown that accelerated migration could be associated with the contribution electrocapillary component.

articleTitle: Analysis of power supplies mutual impedance as a share of aircraft electrical system by Matlab/Simulink
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this paper a new approach to the solution of important problems of electromagnetic compatibility of aircraft power system - determining of the input impedance of secondary switching power supplies as a part of this electrical power system and allows to determine the total impedance of the entire electrical power system of the aircraft. Simulation software Matlab / Simulink is used for solving the problem. An example of using this to the analysis of the power converter is presented.

articleTitle: Interaction of sheet electron beam with a zero space garmonic of comb slow-wave structure in the clinotron
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Results of theoretical studies of interaction of sheet electron beam with a zero space garmonic of comb slow-wave structure are presented. The gain and the efficiency are calculated for different input signal levels and the inclination angle of the electron beam relative to the surface of the slow-wave structure. The results obtained have broadened the concept of clinotron as a terahertz-wave radiation source, which can not only generate but also effectively amplify HF oscillations.

articleTitle: Extreme regulator of adaptive control for the internal combustion engine
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
