abstract: Propose the adaptive method to improve the accuracy of the control advance angle of ignition of gasoline internal combustion engines (ICE) on indicators intracyclic changes in the angular velocity of the crankshaft, allowing to take into account the uneven distribution of the working mixture in the cylinders and change their technical condition. For the extreme regulator of adaptive control for the internal combustion engine justified optimization of the controlled parameter on the basis of the minimum of the coefficient of non-uniformity of the angular velocity of the crankshaft.

articleTitle: The circuit approach to the study of the processes of microwave drying
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article describes the principle of the simulation of microwave drying of dielectrics by the method of equivalent circuits. The mathematical model of the kinetics of the energy and mass transfer in the microwave drying of dielectrics was described. The equivalent circuits simulating the heat and mass transfer was shows. The mathematical simulation results of microwave drying of wood in periodic mode were show. The advantages of the proposed method were described. The conclusion about the successful use of the method of equivalent circuits for modeling of microwave drying and the correctness of its implementation in the program LTSpice was made.

articleTitle: A theoretical basics of microwave networks for software defined radio systems
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article briefly reports the basic concepts and principles related to transmissions lines, modeling of linear networks, defining S parameters, and some elements relevant to microwave metrology and the design of network. The advantages and use of the scattering matrix and scattering parameters are discussed. Examples of the microwave networks provide a whole picture of the problem. Scattering matrix and scattering parameters are used to describe the microwave network and vector analyzer. They could be determined with the help of the reflection coefficient. Also using of the vector analyzer in the software defined radio systems is shown.

articleTitle: Extreme magnetic energy of the electromechanical converter of electromagnetic type
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Relevance of research is caused by need of an assessment of the extreme magnetic energy reserved in working gaps of the electromechanical converter of electromagnetic type at saturated magnetic system at a stage of start-off of an anchor. As the electromechanical converter the pulse linear electromagnetic engine can be used. Such assessment will allow to reveal ways of increase of specific power indicators of pulse linear electromagnetic engines. By means of the offered approximation of a curve of magnetization of a magnetic conductor of the converter the sedate polynom of the ninth degree has analytically received dependence of extreme magnetic energy on design data of the converter. It has allowed to estimate influence of initial inductance of the converter and extent of saturation on the reserved magnetic energy. So, at change of the generalized design data from 45° to 25° that corresponds to transition from magnetic system, one-shameful into a two-shameful design, the size of extreme magnetic energy of pulse linear electromagnetic engine will increase three and more.

articleTitle: Multi-tubular dual-frequency resonators for multi-beam klystrons low-voltage working in Ka-frequency range
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper presents the results of numerical simulation multi-tubular dual-frequency resonators for multi-beam klystrons working in Ka-band frequency with an output power level of the order a kilowatt at a cathode voltage of 4 kV. To improve efficiency in the output resonator implemented simultaneous adjustment of the resonator frequency of the first and third harmonics of the convection current (30 and 90 GHz). Found operating conditions, which provide effective interaction of multi-electron beam with a high-frequency electromagnetic field. The paper compares the parameters of the resonators with different numbers of the drift tubes.

articleTitle: Improved calculation of space charge forces in nonstationary electron beams
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The method of space charge forces calculation in nonstationary electron beams using boundary elements equations are proposed. For 1D task the consistent scheme of distribution between mesh points of particle charges and calculation of electric field acting on particle is considered. This scheme eliminates effect «self-action» of particles but decreases the accuracy of force acting between two particles placed in one cell of mesh. Upon well known equation for potential in calculated area for integral equation method the radial and axial components of electric field from ring particle is founded for 2D axial model by differentiation of this equation.

articleTitle: Mathematical modeling of heat microwave dielectric chamber in 3D printer
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: One of the areas is a 3D printing frequency (RF) dielectric heating is used to intensify heat treatment of various dielectric materials used for constructing 3D models. Electrotechnological microwave system with 3D printer allows you to accelerate the process of prototyping, and eliminate disadvantages such as deformation of the object and resize when sintering at use as a material of clays and other ceramic precursors. During the heat treatment of solid dielectrics in microwave field significant temperature-deformations can occur in them. For processes such as drying of ceramics, for example, the occurrence of thermal deformations and cracks unacceptable. Considered program mathematical moderating the heating process of multilayer dielectric in a microwave chamber of the radial type. The dielectric acts polymer clay. Analyzed the advantages and disadvantages of the drying process of polymer clay in a microwave field. Shows the algorithm of the program, the output, and the options of the application of other fields of technology.

articleTitle: Determine the sensivity of the magnetic field of the ring magnet with a trapezoidal cross-sectional variations in different geometrical parameters
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Article presents of the results the calculation of the first order derivative of the magnetic induction in the ring magnet with a trapezoidal cross-section. Shows graphs of the magnetic field and the derivative of the magnetic field from the magnet thickness for three different magnets. Give a formula for calculating the magnetic field sensitivity from the change in the thickness of the magnetic field. On the graph of the derivative of the magnetic field, shows the dependence of the magnetic field sensitivity at change the thickness computed in various ways: analytical, graphical and calculated by using Microsoft Exel.

articleTitle: Gain analisys of O-type THz devices with sheet electron beam
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper is aimed at development of miniaturized THz O-type devices with sheet electron beam. A 0,2 THz traveling-wave tube amplifier with a staggered double-grating slow-wave structure (SWS) is designed. The results of calculation of small-signal and large-signal gain are presented. The calculations predict 15–20 dB small-signal gain and up to 100 W saturation power in the amplifier with 20 kV 0,1 A sheet electron beam. In addition, a cascaded amplifier with two short SWS sections separated by the drift space is considered.

articleTitle: Increase of durability of powder composite materials with hierarchical structure in the microwave oven the electromagnetic field
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: As a method of formation of hierarchical structure of fillers of the waveguide paths of microwave devices it is offered to use additive technologies. Researches of influence of the microwave oven of an electromagnetic field of various specific power on strength characteristics of objects are made of the powder materials created by 3D press. It is established that the microwave oven an electromagnetic field with a specific power up to 30 W/cm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</sup> with a frequency of 2450 MHz causes increase in flexural durability of the plates from the powder Zp130 impregnated tsianokrilaty Z-BondTM90 to 1,77 times. Thus reduction of the sizes of a time by 24 % and decrease in their dispersion on almost for 30% is observed.

articleTitle: The theoretical and experimental research of the center frequency of an anisotropic Bragg cell as a function of the period of a multiunit transducer
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Modern development trend systems of wireless devices reconnaissance are to magnify operating frequency and expand bandwidth of radar impulses. Acousto-optic Bragg cells are commonly used as message entry device in such systems and thus entire system operation depends on its characteristics. Therefore enhancing performance of acousto-optic Bragg cells is a relevant objective. One the characteristics of acousto-optic device is a centrer frequency for wideband operation. The comparative analysis theoretical and experimental results of the research of the centrer frequency for wideband operation of an anisotropic Bragg cell with multiunit transducer as function of its period is given.

articleTitle: Microwave method of polymeric composite pipes curing
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Theoretical and experimental results of curing of polymer composite pipes with the use of microwave radiation energy are presented. The results of studies on the accelerated curing of polymer composite pipes with diameter of 2000 mm, thickness of 36 mm at a temperature of +200°C and at anelectromagnetic field frequency oscillation of 2450 MHz and the output microwave power of 115 kW in a beam-type microwave device are given. The temperature deviation from the nominal value on the outer surface of the pipe is absent, and in the thickness of pipe does not exceed 5°C. A method of composite pipes curing can reduce energy costs, increase productivity and improve working conditions of staff.

articleTitle: Excitation of the rectangular cavity with a set of horns for uniform microwave heating
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The stationary (harmonic) excitation of the rectangular resonator with an absorbing dielectric layer on the lower wall several rectangular horns located on the top and side walls has been considered. With the end walls of the cavity it is possible the conveyor feed of dielectric product, for what is absorbing filter loaded with absorbers and prevent the exit of energy from the resonator. The filter impedance is modeled by an absorbing impedance wall. Besides the presence of perfect reflecting walls for modeling of microwave processing with a single time product download is considered. The simulation of excitation by horns is produced by a given field. The fields in the discloses are represented as fields H<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</inf>-wave of the respective waveguides, the amplitude of which is associated with the power of the sources (magnetrons). These exciting fields are modeled as magnetic surface currents. The task allows to carry out the optimization, whereas optimization packages such as HFSS involves substantial computational costs.

articleTitle: The failure of traditional methods of determining statistical distribution functions of the units of vacuum and plasma electronics
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: It has been shown that traditional diagnostic methods associated with the solution of inverse problems described by Fredholm integral equation of the 1st kind from a mathematical point of view, are failure, because they do not take into account their ill posed problems. The ill posed problems is connected c on the one hand with the ambiguity of the inverse problem solution and on the other hand with a huge quantity of a matrix of transition from the experimental results to the desired values. Proposed diagnostic method associated with functional Tikhonov minimization. Monte Carlo method the convergence to the exact solution with an error of initial information tends to zero. The practical results of applying the proposed method for the diagnosis of the distribution function in the emission, plasma, solid and nano-electronics.

articleTitle: Development of X/Ku-broadband powerful TWT
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This paper presents the results of numerical simulation and experimental researches of high power broadband TWT in X/Ku frequency range. Described TWT provides the output power more than 500 W with the operating frequency greater than 1 octave and gain coefficient more than 30 dB. In this TWT is used periodic magnetic focusing system for maintaining the electron beam. TWT has a waveguide output and double-stage collector. TWT has an air-cooling system. In this paper is also described the design philosophy of TWT, presented electrodynamic characteristics of slow-wave structure, TWT interaction space features. Also in this work are presented test data of TWT prototypes.

articleTitle: Microstrip transmission line for determing dielectric constant of nanocomposite films in MW rang
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A short overview of measuring methods for dielectric constant in SHF range is given. A 3-D numerical simulation of microstrip structure with a central electrode of an interdigital type loaded onto a thick-film material sample was carried out. Resonance frequencies of wavelengths in cm-range depending on dielectric constant of the measured sample were determined. A correlation between resonance frequency shift and dielectric constant of the nanocomposite sample loaded onto interdigital structure was determined. It was found out that depending on dielectric constant value a shift along the frequency of attenuation pole takes place in the following manner: when e>1 — to lesser frequencies and when e<1 — to bigger frequencies. Capacity distribution in interdigital structure was studied at different modes. Analogue circuit of microstrip line with interdigital structure is provided. Application of this structure for determining dielectric constant of nanocomposite samples in SHF range was studied. Advantages of this line as compared to standard misrostrip line for measuring dielectric constant of nanocomposite films in SHF range were established. A manufactured sample of microstrip line with central interdigital type electrode was shown.

articleTitle: A study of triggered vacuum switch interrupting capability
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper describes the results of tests performed to obtain interrupting capability parameters of triggered vacuum switches. The switches used in all tests had sealed-off designs with lengths of the main discharge gaps of about 1 mm. The experimental conditions covered a range of peak currents of 1 to 5 kA with current fall rates up to 5 kA/μs. The upper level of commutated voltage (∼5 kV) was limited by static self-breakdown of the switches. The obtained results demonstrated that stable interruption of pulse vacuum arc and reverse recovery of the switches occurred at the current fall rates under 0.5 kA/μs.

articleTitle: Study of principle of operation of P-I-N diode with application of the fundamentals of wavelet analysis
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Study of p-i-n diode with application of wavelet transform to analyze the characteristics. Includes laboratory workshop, including laboratory stand with a description of the individual components of the installation, allowing to obtain the characteristics of p-i-n diode for further study using wavelet analysis. The article analyzes data using wavelet transform based on the upgraded software product «labpraktikum_osnov_wavelet», consisting of several modules, among which «Building the periodogram and spectrogram», «Continuous wavelet transform», «Calculating wavelet coefficients at scales 1 and 9 at different steps of the wavelet transform».

articleTitle: Hybrid types of waves in the ridged waveguide with the piecewise-layered dielectric filling
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article considers the possibility of using the ridged waveguide as a measuring cell of devices for determining permittivity of materials. The calculations of electromagnetic fields of hybrid waves were performed for the ridged waveguide with the piecewise-layered dielectric filling by the method of partial regions in view of the behavior features of electromagnetic fields on the dielectric and metal edges. Structures of electromagnetic fields of HE-waves and graphs of the propagation constants on the wave numbers for different permittivity of dielectrics are shown.

articleTitle: The microstrip diplexers with adjacent bandwidths, based on 2D electromagnetic crystal
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The diplexers based on 2D electromagnetic crystal are investigated with the help of the numerical electrodynamic analysis of 3D models. The input half-wave resonator has rolled up strip conductor in the claimed microstrip designs tuned with nearly adjacent bandwidths. It allows to coordinate channels rather easily. Such resonator in the first two-channel device at the same time interacts with pair of quarter-wave resonators having strip conductors in the form of the Russian letter «Π». In the second two-channel device it interacts similarly, with pair of resonators with strip conductors in the form of a letter «III». Build-up of number of periodically located rectangular portions of strip conductors in adjacent resonators allows to increase in proportion number of the resonances participating in formation of both low-frequency, and high-frequency bandwidths. At the same time in amplitude-frequency characteristics of diplexers growth of the steepness of slopes of adjacent bandwidths and gain suppression of power at frequencies of stop bands are observed.

articleTitle: Software modeling longitudinal magnetic field distribution magnetic focusing systems
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article deals with the software simulation of the longitudinal distribution of the magnetic field magnetic focusing systems (MFS), based on the summation of different types of wavelet functions (upgraded wavelet “French hat”, the summation of unipolar wavelet function Gauss second-order shift, the summation wavelet-functions “French hat” and Gaussian first order). Simulation of various types of MFS is divided into two main stages. The first step is modeling of longitudinal magnetic field distribution of the cell of MFS (single magnet). The second stage is the modeling of longitudinal magnetic field distribution of MFS given the previous model (single magnet), which is implemented using real mechanism of the formation of the distribution.

articleTitle: Integrated research chemical composition of black cathode foil electrical capacitors
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Complex investigations of the chemical composition of the surface layer of the cathode foil with a black sequential application of layers of titanium and titanium nitride as a function of the process fluid in the working chamber of the vacuum plant. The operation of the equipment, a method of manufacturing the cathode foil by applying a porous coating in which the material occurs in a vacuum evaporation and condensation of vapor on the aluminum foil is rewound in the vacuum chamber of the module over the two evaporation zones.

articleTitle: Characteristics of image blur of the round mark during vibration movement along Z axis
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article defines the current importance and possibility of implementation of new techniques for measuring vibration movement of the material point flatwise to the object. The basis of this techniques is the indirect measurement of the absolute value of radius increase of the round mark, caused by its blurring due to vibration movement of the studied material point, located in the geometrical center of the mark. The research proved higher precision of this technique as compared with similar ones. The article describes the experiment carried out by the researchers, analyses its results in the form of calibration characteristics of the measurement system. This calibration characteristics is presented in table and graphic formats and approximated by a right line. The article justifies the linearity of converting the measured value into measured signal.

articleTitle: Nanotechnology features of vacuumelectron devices
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Technologies of vacuum electron devices and their prospects of development based on nanotechnological approaches are considered. It is shown that the vacuum electron devices operation inevitably leads to a change in original characteristics of device elements in nanoregions due to intensive mutual influence of its parts with different properties and functions in consequence of the combination of these parts into a single electrodynamical, geometrical and physical-chemical system. The general directions based on nanotechnological approaches for the reconstruction of basic technologies of vacuum electron devices are proposed.

articleTitle: Parasitic self-excitation of powerful cavity-type devices in static mode and methods of their suppression
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The work shows research of parasitic self-excitation of powerful cavity-type devices in static mode. Analysis program of parasitic self-excitation for multibeam klystron, traveling wave tube on a chain of coupled cavities and klystrons with distributed interaction is presented. A method of suppressing the parasitic self-excitation in the working range of accelerating voltages multibeam klystron is proposed. The experiment results showed.

articleTitle: Radiation interaction of nonlinear electron oscillators in a small volume of the active resonant medium at electrostatic focusing
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: It is shown that in the area of three-dimensional interaction radiation communication system of oscillators leads to a build-up phase group and the total dipole moment in time. Within the framework of a simplified three-dimensional problem studied self-excitation of the small portion of the active medium. In addition to the cross motion of electrons in each ensemble accounted longitudinal movement and interaction of a large number of bands shifted in the longitudinal direction. As time non-linear effects on the three-dimensional portion of the active medium result in the achievement of steady-state generation with weak fluctuations of the total dipole moment. The magnitude of dipole moment determines the intensity of the vortex radiation fields in the far field.

articleTitle: Automatic climate control system
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The article describes the problem of local climate control «problem»» areas in industrial premises. Structural diagram of the automatic control system is presented. The basis of the automatic control system is a controller made by the scheme of the classical proportional-integral-derivative controller. This will ensure that the identity of the microclimate parameters of the working environment at all points in the room, regardless of its geometry, provide the required safety conditions of the operating personnel.

articleTitle: Reseach on how the size of the high-ohmic sections of the compact branch-line coupler affects its characteristics
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Nowadays such super-high frequency devices as a microstrip branch-line coupler are widely used in present day's radio technical systems. This article contains an analysis of how thickness of the compact two-branch-line coupler's thin elements affects its characteristics. A constructions miniaturization procedure involves replacement of a microstrip transmission line section by a lowpass filter, which has the same phase shift as the replaced section. Constructions modeling is carried out and its frequency-response characteristics are obtained. Based on the research findings, it may be concluded that the accuracy of the compact elements manufacturing is very important when manufacturing samples.

articleTitle: Methods of digital filtering in the tasks of information and measuring analysis and compression of panoramic videoimages of road traffic
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Considered the problem of megacities traffic, offers methods and discusses prospects of using spatial-time filtering for digital road traffic panoramic images in the task of automatic detection of the projection of asphalt pavement, presented the results of experimental studies on the subject, shown advantages of automatic measuring system on the basis of that solution. The essence of the proposed technical solution consists in the mixing of time and spatial filtering, used for the detection of the projection of asphalt pavement in the panoramic videoimages of traffic flows. To solve this problem were used the low-pass filters. After applying time filter for cars in the picture begins to emerge their filtration trail, that shows where the moving cars, and therefore the asphalt pavement. Thanks to inertial properties of applied filters spatial filtering accelerates this process and the action of this filter extends to a few more pixels along the coordinate axis. However, at the same time, the spatial filter distorts the automobile projection from the other side. For this reason, the article proposes an algorithm that takes into account both positive and negative implications of the spatial filter. In general, thanks to a spatial-temporal filtering the time, required to identify the boundaries of the projection asphalt coating, was reduced by about 20 %. This is a favorable factor for statistical analysis and compression of such video.

articleTitle: Features of formation of nano-structured plasma-sprayed titanium coating in the manufacture of electronics
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: In this work we studied properties of nano structures electro-plasma powder titanium coatings which are widely used in the manufacture of electronic devices. The relationship between the main functional and operating properties of coatings spraying technology parameters such as arc current, spraying distance and dispersion of sprayed material was studied. The results of examination of the physic-mechanical and gas vacuum properties of plasma coating are presented and the effect of the most important spraying parameters on these coatings is studied. The investigation were carried out on a wide range of plasma-sprayed coatings from powder. production under different technological spraying conditions. The morphology of the individual sprayed nano-sized coating elements was shown. The results are used as a basis for developing, selecting and efficient application into production of optimum technologies of plasma treatment of materials. Possibility of obtaining of structurally organized coatings by method of managed process of plasma spraying is explained.

articleTitle: Carbon nanostructures multilayer grafenov to create electrically conductive composites drives of energy
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: Methods are presented for creation of technology of production of graphene materials with the developed surface, containing different functional groups and wares from these substances as electrode materials of stores of energy. Applications developed graphene materials gives a large effect in such areas as the electrically conductive composite materials, coatings, shielding or reflecting electromagnetic radiation in a wide frequency range and the elements of nanoelectronics.

articleTitle: Optimal parameters of parametric generation in crossed fields
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: This report summarizes the results obtained in the papers relating to the generation of high frequency signal in crossed electric and magnetic fields. We consider the radial resonator system, with two coaxial cylinders and inhomogeneous magnetic induction, and determine electron trajectories in crossed fields. Trajectories were determined in case of ac magnetic and electric fields with other frequency sequences. Election trajectories calculated numerically by Runge-Kutta IV order of accuracy. We investigate the behavior of the output characteristics of the parametric generation in crossed fields. In final we demonstrated optimal parameters for that generation.

articleTitle: A RFID reader based on combined multi-port reflectometer
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: A use automatic network analyzer based on down conversion of measuring frequency of multi-port reflectometer ports' responses is proposed to overcome the problem of weak tag signal blocking by a high-power carrier signal from reader. This approach does not require the carrier signal reader compensation. The basic measuring equations of the new meter are obtained. The advantages of the proposed meter are discussed. Measurement and calibration algorithms of radio frequency identification reader based on a multi-channel vector voltmeter are discussed in the paper. The calibration algorithm is founded on initial estimation of incident and reflected wave complex amplitudes when only the responses of multi-probe transmission line reflectometer are considered. The basic equations of the method are given. The results of computer simulation of measuring and calibration processes confirming the theoretical conclusions are given.

articleTitle: Practical issues of implementation improved spectrum output voltage in power switched-mode generators
publicationTitle: 2016 International Conference on Actual Problems of Electron Devices Engineering (APEDE)
abstract: The paper presents the ways of improving output voltage spectrum in switched-mode generators. Because of errors arising while setting the transistors' switching times, it is rather difficult to achieve the required compensation of higher harmonics. Switching times errors are caused by the inertia of the switching process in power transistors as well as sampling errors of control devices. Analysis has shown that error of 2–3 deg. in multilevel voltage leads to an increase of higher harmonics to the level −38 … −42 dB. This problem can be solved by introducing an amendment of control pulses time position enabling to decrease these errors. The optimal values of the sampling frequency enabling to achieve effective compensation of higher harmonics are provided.
